items.title: Xogo horleh oo ka soo kordhay weerarkii masaajidka San Diego
items.description: Weerar hubeysan oo ka dhacay masaajid ku yaalla magaalada San Diego ayaa sababay dhimashada saddex qof, iyadoo waardiye amni oo lagu magacaabi jiray Amin Abdullah lagu tilmaamay geesi badbaadiyay nolosha dad badan kadib markii uu ka hortagay weerarka. Booliska ayaa sheegay in Amin Abdullah, oo ahaa aabbe leh sideed carruur ah kana shaqeynayay xarunta Islamic Center of San Diego, uu si toos ah uga hor tagay laba dhalinyaro ah oo weerarka fuliyay xilli ay isku dayayeen inay gudaha u galaan masaajidka. Sidoo kale waxa uu dhaqaajiyay nidaamka xiritaanka degdegga ah ee xarunta, taas oo la sheegay inay badbaadisay cibaadeysanayaal badan oo ay ku jireen carruur dhigata iskuulka ku xiran masaajidka. Taliyaha Booliska San Diego, Scott Wahl, ayaa sheegay in tallaabada Abdullah ay si weyn uga hortagtay khasaaro dheeraad ah, waxa uuna sheegay in labada weeraryahan oo da’doodu ahayd 17 iyo 18 jir ay rasaas fureen xilli ay isku dayayeen inay gudaha u galaan xarunta, kadibna meydadkooda laga helay goobta iyadoo loo maleynayo inay isdileen. Labada qof ee kale ee weerarka ku dhintay ayaa lagu kala magacaabay Mansour Kaziha iyo Nader Awad, sida ay xaqiijisay xarunta Council on American-Islamic Relations San Diego. Saraakiisha baaritaanka wada ayaa sheegay in dhacdadan loo baarayo suuragalnimada inay tahay weerar naceyb ku saleysan, ayadoo booliska ay tilmaameen in hadallo naceyb iyo fikrado xagjirnimo ah ay qeyb ka ahaayeen weerarka, inkastoo aan weli si rasmi ah loo shaacin sababta dhabta ah.

items.title: Soomaaliya oo koronto raqiis ah ka soo dhoofsaneysa Itoobiya – Sidee?
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Xukuumadda Soomaaliya ayaa ku dhawaaqday qorshe ay koronto uga soo dhoofsanayso dalka Itoobiya, taasi oo soo mari doonta seddex magaalo muhiimka ah ee xadka ku yaalla. Wasiirka Tamarka iyo Kheyraadka biyaha C/llaahi Bidhaan Warsame ayaa sheegay inay dowladdu rajo wanaagsan ka qabto in qorshahaani uu noqon doono mid Soomaaliya ay ku heli doonto koronto qiimaheedu hooseeyo oo noqon doona halkii kilowatt $5 cent, taas oo si weyn uga hoosaysa qiimaha korontada ee hadda laga bixiyo Soomaaliya. Wasiir Bidhaan ayaa intaa raaciyay in koronta laga keenayo Itoobiya lasoo marsiin doono deegaanada xuduudaha Doolow, Wajaale, iyo Goldogob, isagoo qiray in mar hore la dhameeyay labo meelood oo korontada soo mareyso. Bankiga Adduunka oo qorshahaan taageerayo wuxuu qirsan yahay in Soomaaliya ay ka mid tahay wadamada qiimaha korontada ee ugu qaalisan qaaradda Afrika, iyadoo magaalooyinka qaar ay qiimuhu u dhaxeeyaan 60 ilaa 100 cent halkii kilowatt. Dalka Itoobiya ayaa dhaliya wax ka badan 6,000 oo megawatt oo koronto ah, sida ay sheegtay dowladda Itoobiya iyo xogta Bankiga Horumarinta Afrika, iyadoo inta badan tamartaas laga dhaliyo mashaariicda biyaha ee mashruuca biyo xireenka Weyn ee Itoobiya Grand Ethiopian Renaissance Dam (Gerd). Waddamada Geeska Afrika ayaa muddooyinkii dambe sii kordhiyey mashaariicda isku-xirka korontada gobolka, kuwaas oo ujeedkoodu yahay in lagu ballaariyo helitaanka korontada iyo in la dhimmo kharashka tamarta ee suuqyada isku xiran. Tallaabadan ayaa ah dhabbo weyn oo loo qaaday dhanka xallinta koronto la’aanta baahsan ee ka jirta dalka iyo xoojinta iskaashiga gobolka iyo dadaallada ballaaran ee lagu horumarinayo helitaanka tamarta iyo xiriirka dhaqaale ee ka dhexeeya labada waddan ee Geeska Afrika. Wasiirka Tamarka iyo Kheyraadka biyaha C/llaahi Bidhaan Warsame ayaa sheegay inay dowladdu rajo wanaagsan ka qabto in qorshahaani uu noqon doono mid Soomaaliya ay ku heli doonto koronto qiimaheedu hooseeyo oo noqon doona halkii kilowatt $5 cent, taas oo si weyn uga hoosaysa qiimaha korontada ee hadda laga bixiyo Soomaaliya. Wasiir Bidhaan ayaa intaa raaciyay in koronta laga keenayo Itoobiya lasoo marsiin doono deegaanada xuduudaha Doolow, Wajaale, iyo Goldogob, isagoo qiray in mar hore la dhameeyay labo meelood oo korontada soo mareyso. Bankiga Adduunka oo qorshahaan taageerayo wuxuu qirsan yahay in Soomaaliya ay ka mid tahay wadamada qiimaha korontada ee ugu qaalisan qaaradda Afrika, iyadoo magaalooyinka qaar ay qiimuhu u dhaxeeyaan 60 ilaa 100 cent halkii kilowatt. Dalka Itoobiya ayaa dhaliya wax ka badan 6,000 oo megawatt oo koronto ah, sida ay sheegtay dowladda Itoobiya iyo xogta Bankiga Horumarinta Afrika, iyadoo inta badan tamartaas laga dhaliyo mashaariicda biyaha ee mashruuca biyo xireenka Weyn ee Itoobiya Grand Ethiopian Renaissance Dam (Gerd). Waddamada Geeska Afrika ayaa muddooyinkii dambe sii kordhiyey mashaariicda isku-xirka korontada gobolka, kuwaas oo ujeedkoodu yahay in lagu ballaariyo helitaanka korontada iyo in la dhimmo kharashka tamarta ee suuqyada isku xiran. Tallaabadan ayaa ah dhabbo weyn oo loo qaaday dhanka xallinta koronto la’aanta baahsan ee ka jirta dalka iyo xoojinta iskaashiga gobolka iyo dadaallada ballaaran ee lagu horumarinayo helitaanka tamarta iyo xiriirka dhaqaale ee ka dhexeeya labada waddan ee Geeska Afrika. items.title: Dowladda Federaalka oo gacan bir ah ku qabaneysa Baydhabo
items.description: Kaaliyaha Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, General Maadey Nuurey Sheekh Ufurow ayaa maanta gaaray Magaalada Baydhabo ee Gobolka Baay, si uu u riixo dadaalada socda ee is bedelka amni lagaga sameynayo magaaladaasi. Saraakiisha Ciidamada Qalabka Sida ayaa Magaalada Baydhabo ka wada kulamo looga hadlayo, sidii wax looga qaban lahaa falalka amni darrada ee muddooyinkanba ku soo badanayay magaaladaasi. Kaaliyaha Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ayaa waxaa Garoonka Shaati-gaduud ku soo dhaweeyay Taliye Kuxigeenka Ciidanka Dhulka ee Xoogga Dalka, General Cabdullaahi Aadan Xuseen (Cirro), Wasiirka cusub ee Amniga Koonfur Galbeed, Maxamed Xuseen Xasan (Joon) iyo Saraakiil kale. Intaasi ka dib, Sarkaalka labaad ee ugu sarreya Militariga Somaliya ayaa loo gelbiyay Xarunta Madaxtooyada Koonfur Galbeed, halkaas oo uu kulan kula leeyahay Hoggaamiyaha KMG Koonfur Galbeed, Jibriil Cabdirashiid Xaaji Cabdi. General Maadey Nuurey Sheekh Ufurow, Taliye Kuxigeenka Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ayaa ku biiraya kulamada looga hadlayo amniga magaalada, si uu khibraddiisa ugu biiriyo hay’adaha ammaanka. Dowladda Federaalka ayaa waxay u muuqataa mid dhageysaneysa walaaca amni ee ay qabaan dadka reer Baydhabo, iyadoo xiisadda siyaasadeed iyo kororka falalka amni darrada ay xitaa wiiqi karaan geeddi-socodka xilliga kala guurka ee Koonfur Galbeed iyo doorashada ka socota maamulkaasi. Dowladda Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa xoogga saareysa, sidii loo xakamayn lahaa culeyska amni ay magaalada ku hayaan ciidamada taabacsan Madaxweynihii Koonfur Galbeed, Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed (Laftagareen) ee awoodda laga tuuray daba-yaaqadii bishii March. Laftagareen oo in ka badan toddobo sano madax u ahaa Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed ayaa 30-kii bishii lagu khasbay in uu ka baxo Magaalada Baydhabo, laakiin bixitaankiisii waxay cawaaqib amni ku yeelatay dadka deegaanka. Xaaladaha amni ee ku hareereysan Baydhabo ayaa ah kuwo is bedbedelaya, dadkuna ma ahan wax ay sanadihii u dambeeyay la qabsadeen. Si kastaba ha-ahaatee General Ufurow ayaa noqonaya janaraalkii labaad ee ay Dowladda Federaalka u dirto Baydhabo, wax ka yar hal toddobaad. Jimcihii ayaa waxaa magaalada gaaray General Cirro, isagoo qiimeynaya daldaloolooyinka amniga ee ka jira magaalada. Imaanshaha General Ufurow ee magaalada ayaa sidoo kale wanaajineysaa niyadda ciidamada.

items.title: Madaxweyne Cirro Oo Daah Furay
items.description: 𝐌𝐚𝐝𝐚𝐱𝐰𝐞𝐲𝐧𝐚𝐡𝐚 𝐉𝐚𝐦𝐡𝐮𝐮𝐫𝐢𝐲𝐚𝐝𝐝𝐚 𝐒𝐨𝐦𝐚𝐥𝐢𝐥𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐎𝐨 𝐃𝐚𝐚𝐡-𝐟𝐮𝐫𝐚𝐲 𝐌𝐚𝐜𝐡𝐚𝐝𝐤𝐚 𝐂𝐚𝐚𝐥𝐚𝐦𝐢𝐠𝐚 𝐚𝐡 𝐞𝐞 𝐌𝐚𝐝𝐚𝐱𝐛𝐚𝐧𝐧𝐚𝐚𝐧𝐢𝐝𝐚 𝐢𝐲𝐨 𝐀𝐪𝐨𝐨𝐧𝐬𝐢𝐠𝐚 𝐒𝐨𝐦𝐚𝐥𝐢𝐥𝐚𝐧𝐝 Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland, Mudane Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdilaahi (Cirro) ayaa si rasmi ah u daah-furay Machadka Caalamiga ah ee Madaxbannaanida iyo Aqoonsiga Somaliland (𝗦𝗼𝗺𝗮𝗹𝗶𝗹𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗜𝗻𝗱𝗲𝗽𝗲𝗻𝗱𝗲𝗻𝗰𝗲 𝗥𝗲𝗰𝗼𝗴𝗻𝗶𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻 𝗜𝗻𝘀𝘁𝗶𝘁𝘂𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻), oo ah Xarun Cilmi-baadhis iyo Diblomaasiyadeed oo heer Caalami ah oo lagu xoojinayo Doodaha sharci, Taariikheed, Siyaasadeed iyo xaqa aaya-ka-tashiga Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland. Madaxweynuhu waxa uu sheegay in furitaanka Machadkani uu muujinayo bisaylka Dawladnimada Somaliland iyo sida ay Shacabka Somaliland uga go’an tahay ilaalinta Madaxbannaanidooda iyo xaqiijinta himilada aqoonsi buuxa oo caalami ah. Waxa uu xusay in Machadku uu door weyn ka qaadan doono Cilmi-baadhista, faafinta iyo kaydinta Sooyaalka Sharci iyo taariikheed ee Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland, isla markaana uu noqon doono Madal isku xidha Aqoonyahanka, Taariikh-yahanka, Sharci-yaqaannada, Diblomaasiyiinta iyo saaxiibbada Somaliland ee Dunida. Sidoo kale, Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland waxa uu tilmaamay in Machadkani uu gacan ka geysan doono xoojinta doodaha aqoonsi raadiska, horumarinta daraasadaha la xidhiidha nabadda iyo dawlad-dhiska, kobcinta xidhiidhka Hay’adaha Caalamiga ah, iyo Wacyi-gelinta Jiilasha cusub ee ku saabsan qiimaha Qarannimada iyo jiritaanka Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland. Madaxweynuhu waxa uu hoosta ka xarriiqay in Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland ay muddo ka badan 35 sano ku naaloonaysay nabad, kala dambayn, horumar Dimuqraadiyad, iyo Dawladnimo shaqaynaysa, taas oo uu sheegay in ay Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland siinayso xaq Sharci iyo mudnaan ay kaga mid noqon karto Beesha Caalamka.

items.title: Midowga Afrika oo ku baaqay hal cod oo adduunka ah
items.description: Libreville, 20 May 2026 – Guddoomiyaha Guddiga Midowga Afrika (AU), Mudane Maxamuud Cali Yuusuf, ayaa maanta si rasmi ah u furay shir albaabada u xiran oo ay isugu yimaadeen Wakiillada Gaarka ah, Wakiillada Sare iyo Wakiillada Joogtada ah, kaas oo ka horreeya dib-u-gurashadii 17-aad ee Heerka Sare ee ku saabsan Horumarinta Nabadda, Amniga iyo Xasilloonida Afrika ee lagu qabanayo Libreville. Shirkani wuxuu yimid xilli Afrika ay la tacaalayso caqabado dhaqaale iyo siyaasadeed oo kala duwan, iyadoo ay sii kordheyso kala qaybsanaanta juqraafiyeed iyo tartanka istiraatiijiyadeed ee caalamka. Guddoomiyuhu waxa uu ku baaqay in Afrika ay ka gudubto in lagu eego bartilmaameedka xiriirka caalamiga ah, una qaato doorka jilaa istiraatiiji ah. “Afrika aysan waligood sii ahaan doonin bartilmaameedka xiriirka caalamiga ah, balse waxay tahay inay noqoto jilaa istiraatiiji ah oo qaabeeya xalalka dhibaatooyinka qaaradda iyo kuwa caalamiga ah,” ayuu yiri Guddoomiyaha Maxamuud Cali Yuusuf khudbaddiisii furitaanka. “Joogitaanka siyaasadeed ee Midowga Afrika ee goobta iyo gudaha shirarka dhinacyada badan leh wuxuu noqday mid muhiim ah oo istiraatiijiyadeed.” Guddoomiyuhu waxa uu intaas ku daray in la xoojiyo qaab-dhismeedka istiraatiijiyadeed ee gobolka, la xoojiyo diblomaasiyadda ka hortagga ah, iyo isku-dubarid ballaaran oo diblomaasiyadda Afrika ah oo ka dhaca caasimadaha muhiimka ah sida Brussels, Geneva, New York, Beijing iyo Qaahira. Inkastoo ay jiraan caqabado dhaqaale, Guddoomiyuhu wuxuu xaqiijiyay in Midowga Afrika uu si adag uga go’an yahay horumarinta nabadda, xasilloonida iyo hindisaha Aamusiinta Qoryaha. Waxa uu ku baaqay in Afrika ay ku hadasho hal cod oo xooggan oo mideysan masraxa adduunka. Saddexda maalmood ee shirka dib-u-soo-noqoshada waxaa lagu soo bandhigi doonaa ka qaybgalka Guddiga Midowga Afrika ee Wise (Guddiga Odayaasha), iyo sidoo kale kulan gaar ah oo lala yeelan doono wakiillada Xoghayaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay ee ka shaqeeya Afrika. Labada dhinac ayaa laga filayaa inay ka wada hadlaan sidii loo xoojin lahaa iskaashiga iyo taageerada nabadda Afrika.

items.title: Somali Human Rights Body Secures UN Peacebuilding Support
items.description: The Chairperson of the Somali National Human Rights Commission, Dr. Maryan Qaasim, held talks in Mogadishu on Monday with Brian James Williams, Head of the Funding Division at the UN Peacebuilding Fund, to strengthen collaboration on human rights protection and state-building. The meeting comes at a critical juncture as Somalia emerges from decades of conflict and begins to rebuild its national institutions. With the UN Peacebuilding Fund allocating resources to fragile states, this partnership aims to ensure that human rights monitoring and institutional capacity-building remain central to Somalia’s stabilization agenda, an area often underfunded compared to military and political tracks. During the hour-long discussion, both sides explored practical avenues for joint action, focusing on peacebuilding support, advancing human rights, and empowering Somalia’s nascent governance structures. Williams specifically lauded the commission’s rapid deployment of field monitors and its recent reports on civilian protection, which he described as a benchmark for transparency. Qaasim expressed deep appreciation for the UN delegation’s visit to the Commission’s headquarters and acknowledged the consistent backing from the world body. She stressed that only through sustained, fruitful cooperation can the Commission strengthen its operations and expand human rights awareness across Somalia’s federal member states. The Somali National Human Rights Commission was established less than three years ago. Its officials have since faced significant challenges, including limited funding, security constraints, and limited access to detention centers. Monday’s talks signal potential new funding streams for training programs and victim assistance mechanisms. No immediate financial commitment was announced, but Williams confirmed that the Peacebuilding Fund views the commission as a strategic partner for long-term stability.

items.title: Israa’iil oo soo dhaweysay safaaradda Somaliland ee Jerusalem
items.description: Tel Aviv, 20 May 2026 – Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda ee Israa’iil, Mudane Gideon Sa’ar, ayaa maanta soo dhaweeyay go’aanka Madaxweynaha Somaliland, Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdillaahi Cirro, ee lagu dhisayo safaarad ay Somaliland ku yeelanayso magaalada Jerusalem, isaga oo ku tilmaamay tallaabada mid muhiim ah oo sii xoojinaysa xiriirka labada dhinac. Somaliland, oo ah dowlad iskeed ugu dhawaaqday gooni-isu-taagga 1991-kii, ma ahan mid aqoonsi caalami ah heshay, laakiin waxay la wadaagtaa Israa’iil xiriir aan rasmi ahayn oo soo jireen ah. Go’aanka safaaradda lagu furayo Jerusalem – oo ay Israa’iil ku tilmaanto caasimadeeda, halka ay qaar ka mid ah beesha caalamku u arkaan dhul ay qabsadeen – waxa uu noqonayaa tallaabo culus oo siyaasadeed. “Furitaanka safaaradda Somaliland ee Jerusalem wuxuu noqon doonaa tallaabo muhiim ah oo sii xoojinaysa xidhiidhka iyo iskaashiga u dhexeeya labada dal iyo shacabkooda,” ayuu yiri Wasiir Gideon Sa’ar farriin uu ku daabacay Facebook-ka Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Israa’iil. “Waxaan si wadajir ah uga shaqayn doonaa hirgelinta qorshahaasi dhawaan.” Wasiirku wuxuu intaas ku daray in safaaradda Somaliland ay noqon doonto safaaraddii siddeedaad ee laga furo magaalada Jerusalem, isagoo Madaxweyne Cirro ku casuumay inuu booqasho rasmi ah ku tago magaaladaasi. Ilo ka socotay Somaliland ayaa sheegay in Madaxweynuhu uu si fiican uga jawaabay casuumaadda, iyadoo la filayo in la qabto wadahadallo heer sare oo ku aaddan faahfaahinta safaaradda. Tallaabadan ayaa ah mid ka mid ah taxane heshiis oo Israa’iil ay la gashay dalal Afrikaan ah sida Marooko, Suudaan, iyo Koonfur Suudaan, kuwaas oo qaarkood ay safaaraddooda ka fureen Jerusalem. Dhinaca kale, Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaan weli ka hadlin go’aankan, laakiin ilo ka socotaya Muqdisho ayaa sheegay in Soomaaliya ay ku adkeysaneyso midnimada dhuleed ee Soomaaliya, iyadoo Somaliland ay qayb ka tahay dalka. Go’aanka Israa’iil iyo Somaliland ayaa laga yaabaa inuu kordhiyo xiisadda Siyaasadda gobolka Geeska Afrika.

items.title: Somalia Faces Deepening Hunger Crisis as Risk of Famine Emerges in Burhakaba
items.description: Action Against Hunger is warning that the latest Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) analysis reveals rapidly worsening food insecurity and nutrition conditions in the country, including a credible risk of famine in Burhakaba District in Bay Region. The organization has witnessed a significant rise in admissions of severely malnourished children to its stabilization centers across Somalia and is calling for an urgent scale-up of humanitarian assistance to prevent further deterioration and save lives. According to the updated IPC projection for April–June 2026, approximately 6 million people — nearly one in three of the population analyzed — are facing Crisis levels of hunger or worse (IPC Phase 3 or above). Nearly 1.9 million people are in Emergency conditions (IPC Phase 4), almost doubling in severity from the first quarter of 2025. The report also projects that 1.88 million children under five will suffer acute malnutrition in 2026, including nearly 493,000 children expected to suffer Severe Acute Malnutrition (SAM), the deadliest form of hunger. The report identifies the Bay Agropastoral Livelihood Zone as the area with the most alarming deterioration of food security. Within this zone, Burhakaba District has reached extremely critical levels of acute malnutrition (IPC Phase 5), with a Global Acute Malnutrition (GAM) rate of 37.1 percent. Failing Gu rains, soaring food prices, and limited humanitarian food security assistance could worsen the crisis at a time when at least one out of three children in Burhakaba are already expected to be acutely malnourished. Action Against Hunger’s program data confirms the growing malnutrition crisis, recording an average 35% increase in SAM admissions across its stabilization centers between January to March of 2025 and January to March of 2026 (from 1,796 to 2,420 cases). The increases have been particularly severe in the Bayhaw stabilization center (serving the wider Bay region), with a 54% increase, and in the Wajid stabilization center (serving the Bakool region), with a 58% increase in admissions in the same timeframe. “What we are witnessing in Burhakaba and across the Bay region is not a future warning — it is a present emergency,” said Mohamed Abdi Haji, Acting Country Director of Action Against Hunger in Somalia. “A GAM rate of 37 percent means that in some communities, malnutrition is the norm, not the exception. Our teams are already on the ground; we currently support five of the six functional health facilities in Burhakaba district, and we are seeing the consequences of this crisis firsthand in our stabilization centers, where admissions of the most severe malnutrition cases have surged by more than half in some locations.” Food insecurity in Somalia is being driven by a convergence of failed and delayed rains, escalating food prices exacerbated by conflict in the Middle East, internal conflict and insecurity, and displacement. Across the country, deteriorating climatic conditions continue to devastate livelihoods. The April–June Gu rainy season has performed significantly below expectations, extending drought impacts after failed rains during the 2025 Deyr season and a harsh 2026 Jilaal dry season. Livestock losses, failed crop production, shrinking incomes, and soaring fuel and food prices linked to regional instability are pushing families deeper into crisis. Action Against Hunger is calling on the international community to mobilize support and prevent further deterioration of the food insecurity crisis in Somalia. “Somalia has stood on the edge of famine before and pulled back — but only because the world responded in time,” said Haji. “That window is open now, and it will not remain open indefinitely.” Action Against Hunger.

items.title: Saciid Deni oo Mareykanka kala hadlay xaaladda kala guurka Soomaliya
items.description: Garoowe (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Maamul-goboleedka Puntland, Mudane Siciid Cabdullaahi Deni oo uu wehliyo Madaxweyne Ku-xigeenka Ilyaas Cismaan Lugatoor, ayaa maanta kulan la yeeshay wafdi ka socda dowladda Mareykanka, kaas oo uu hoggaaminayo Ku-xigeenka Safiirka Mareykanka ee Soomaaliya ahna sii hayaha xilka Safiirka, Ambassador Justin Davis, iyadoo sidoo kale ay qeyb ka ahaayeen saraakiisha howlgalka Africom, oo uu ka midyahay Col. Shane Jones Taliyaha Howlgalada gaarka ah ee maraykanka ee Africa. Kulanka oo ah mid xasaasi ah ayaa waxaa diiradda lagu saaray arrimo dhowr ah, sida Amniga, Siyaasada iyo horumarinta, sida lagu sheegay qoraal kasoo baxay Madaxtooyada Puntland. Sidoo kale, waxaa kulanka lagu soo qaaday xaaladda kala guurka ah ee uu dalku galay iyo doorka ay ku leedahay Puntland oo haatan kasoo horjeedo muddo kororsiga Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud. Puntland iyo Mareykanka ayaa sidoo kale ka wada hadlay xoojinta xiriirka iskaashi ee labada dhinac, gaar ahaan dhinacyada amniga, maalgashiga, iyo ka faa’idaysiga khayraadka dabiiciga ah ee Puntland, dhinacyada Macdanta, Kalluumeysiga iyo Shidaalka. Dhanka kale, Ku simaha safiirka Maraykanka oo kulanka ka hadlay ayaa boggaadiyey hawlgalada ay ciidamada Puntland ka wadaan buuralayda Calmiskaad iyo guulaha laga gaaray ciribtirka argagixisada. Ugu dambeyn, wuxuu amaanay horumarka iyo nabadgelyada ka jirta Puntland, isaga oo balan qaaday taageerada Dowladda Maraykanka ee dhinacyada adkeynta amniga, baahinta adeegyada bulshada iyo horumarinta dhaqaalaha. Si kastaba, Kulankan ayaa kusoo aaday, iyadoo maalmo kahor ay fashilmeen wada-hadaladii dowladda iyo mucaaradka oo uu gar wadeen ka ahaa Mareykanka. The post Saciid Deni oo Mareykanka kala hadlay xaaladda kala guurka Soomaliya appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Kooxda Arsenal oo 22 sano kadib ku guuleysatay horyaalka Ingiriiska ee Premier League.
items.description: Arseraal oo ka mid ah kooxaha ugu faca weyn uguna kubbadda qurxoon ee horyaalka Ingriiska ayaa xaqiijisay hanashada horyaalkeedii 14aad, kadib barbar dhacii ay gashay kooxa Manchester City oo kula loollameysay horyaalka. Markii ugu dambeysay Arsenal ay qaaddo horyaalka Ingiriiska waxa ay aheyd xilligii uu hooggaaminayay sanaddii 2004tii markaas oo ay qaadeen iyaga oo aan dhinacooda dhulka la dhigin, waana kooxda kaliya ee taariikhda horyaalka Ingiriiska sidaa sameysay. Tababaraha haatan hoggaamiya kooxda ee Arteta oo ah ciyaaryahan horay ugu soo ciyaaray kooxda ayaa ku hoggaamiyay kooxda guushan muhiimka oo ay sugayeen 22 sano. Sidoo kale waxa uu heystaa fursad uu kooxda ku kooxda ugu qaadi karo tartanka caanka ah ee Champions League oo ay kooxdu qaadin intii ay jirtay taariikhda marka uu 30 bishan uu wajaho kooxda PSG ee dalka France.

items.title: Muxuu seynisku ka sheegay sida qiyaamuha u dhacayo?
items.description: Waxaa laga yaabaa in la arko marka dunidu dhamaaneyso qabow, mugdi ama welwel. Waxaa suuragal ah in dagaal iyo burbur ku dhamaado. Kuwani waa qaar ka mid ah aragtiyaha ugu waaweyn ee ku saabsan sida dhammaadka adduunku u ekaan karo mustaqbalka fog, marka qiyaamaha la gaaro. Su’aalaha ugu dahsoon cilmi-seyniska waxaa ka mid ah sida dunida ku noqoneyso mid dhammaata. Seynisyahanada ayaa aaminsan in su’aalaha la xiriira qiyaamaha in ay ka badan yihiin jawaabaha. Si aan u fahanno qaar ka mid ah siyaabaha uu koonku ku dhammaan karo, marka hore waa in aan fahannaa sida uu koonku ku bilowday. Bilowga Koonka Sida ay sheegtay hay’adda sahanka hawada sare Mareykanka ee NASA, waxay cirbixiyeenda ku sheegeen koonku iyo waxkasta oo saaran in ay ku bilowdeen waxa loogu yeero Big Bang. Aragtidani waxay sheegaysaa in qiyaastii 13.8 bilyan oo sano ka hor, koonku uu ahaa walax aad u kulul oo aad isugu urursan, isla markaana uu sii ballaaranayay tan iyo markaas. Koonku wuu sii fidayay, muddo aad u dheer gudahoodna waxaa sameysmay qaab-dhismeedyo sida xiddigo iyo meerayaal. Nidaamka uu koonku ku sii fidayay sida ay seynisyahanada sheegayaan weli way sii socotaa FlashMovie via GettyImages Laakiin xaqiiq ahaan, wax aad u yar ayey seynisyahanada ka kala socdaan adduunka. “Shaqadeennu waxay la mid tahay qof eegaya dhaqanka iyo socodka webi dhan isaga oo aan awoodin in uu si buuxda u qiimeeyo dhammaan dhibcaha biyaha ee ku qulqulaya,” ayuu yiri Prof. Alexandre Zabot, oo ah fiisigis yaqaan ka tirsan Jaamacadda Santa Catarina ee dalka Brazil. Qabow aad u daran Machadka boqortooyada UK u qaabilsan cilmiga xidigaha ee Greenwich wuxuu sheegay, haddii koonku uu sii ballaarto, in tamartiisu ay si aad ah u kala firdhi doonto, iyadoo xidigahana ay sii kala fogaan doonaan ilaa ugu dambayn ay dhici doonto in aanay xiddigo cusub dhalan doonin, xiddigaha jirana ay dabar go’i doonaan. Xaaladdaas waxaa loo yaqaan “Qabowga Weyn” ama “Dhammaadka kulaylka ee koonka”. Aragtidan waxay leedahay in ugu dambayn dhammaan atom-yada koonka ay gaari doonaan heer kuleylkoodu isku dheelitirmo, taasoo sababaysa in wax walba ay ku dhowaadaan in ay joojiyaan dhaqaaqa iyo isbeddelka. Sida aragtidani sheegtay, maalin maalmaha ka mid ah heerkulka adduunka oo dhan wuxuu noqon doonaa isku mid, kadibna wax walba si tartiib tartiib ah ayay u istaagi doonaan. Kala go”weyn Haddii rajadani aysan fiicneyn, waxaa jira aragti kale. Madxafka boqortooyada UK ee Greenwich sida ay sheegeen, aragtidani waxay ku salaysan tahay fikradda ah in koonku ku sii ballaaranayo xawaare sii kordhaya, taas oo ay waddo tamarta mugdiga ah. Haddii tani sii socoto, koonku wuxuu noqon karaa mid aad u xoog badan oo cufisjiidadku aysan awoodin in ay isku hayaan qaab-dhismeedka koonka. Cufisjiidadku wuxuu meerayaasha ku hayaa wareegga qorraxda, wuxuu dhulka ku hayaa meeshiisa, wuxuuna ka hortagaa in bini’aadamku ku lumaan hawada sare. Waa awoodda isku haysa nidaamyada sida xiddigaha, qorraxda, iyo waxyaabo kale. Tamarta mugdiga ah, waa arrin aad u dahsoon, waxayna u muuqataa in ay leedahay saameyn gabi ahaanba ka soo horjeedda. “Weli ma naqaan waxa ay ka samaysan tahay, laakiin waxaan ognahay in ay sababto nooc riixid ah, ama si ka duwan cufisjiidadka,” ayuu sheegay Prof. Zabot. NASA waxay sheegtay in tamarta mugdiga ahi ay sababeyso in koonku ku fido xawaare sii kordhaya. NASA waxay kaloo sheegtay in qiyaastii 68.3 ama ilaa 70 boqolkiiba in koonka oo dhan uu ka kooban yahay tamarta mugdiga ah. Arrintan waxaa markii ugu horreysay la ogaaday dabayaaqadii 1990-meeyadii. Aragtiyo kale Haddii tamarta mugdiga ahi daciifto oo ugu dambayn ay dib isu rogto, cufisjiidadku wuxuu dib u soo jiidi doonaa koonka. NASA waxay sheegaysaa in tani ay horseedi doonto xaalad keenaysa in koonku qarxo. Aragti kale waxay sheegaysaa in koonku mar kale isku laaban karo, kadibna “Big Bang” kale ay dhici karo, taasoo abuureysa koon cusub. Aragtidan waxaa loo yaqaan “Big Bounce”, taas oo sheegaysa in koonka iyo adduunyo kale ay jiri doonto. Xigashada Sawirka, Photo via Getty Images Ma la saadaalin karaa goorta adduunku dhammaan doono? “Ma jiraan wax cadeynaya in kala go’ weyn ama burbur uu dhici doono mustaqbalka” ayuu yiri Prof. Abramow. “Dadka qaar waxay qiyaasaan in dhammaadkani uu dhici doono dhowr tirilyan oo sano kaddib, halka kuwo kale ay sheegaan waqtiyo aad uga dheer,” ayuu hadalkiisa ku daray Prof. Zabot. Cilmi-baaris cusub oo ay soo saartay Jaamacadda Radboud ee Netherlands waxay soo jeedinaysaa in koonku uu sii burburayo oo sii yaraanayo si ka dhakhso badan sidii hore. Haddii koonku ugu yaraan jiro 13.8 bilyan oo sano, wali waxaa u harsan 986.2 bilyan oo sano si uu u gaaro hal tirilyan oo sano. “Xaqiiqdu waxay tahay in seynisku uu wax yar ka ogyahay koonka,” ayuu yiri Prof. Abramow. Qalabka xaddidan ee maanta aan haysanno ayaa adkeynaya in la sameeyo cabbirro sax ah. Source bbc somali

Nidaamka uu koonku ku sii fidayay sida ay seynisyahanada sheegayaan weli way sii socotaa FlashMovie via GettyImages Laakiin xaqiiq ahaan, wax aad u yar ayey seynisyahanada ka kala socdaan adduunka. “Shaqadeennu waxay la mid tahay qof eegaya dhaqanka iyo socodka webi dhan isaga oo aan awoodin in uu si buuxda u qiimeeyo dhammaan dhibcaha biyaha ee ku qulqulaya,” ayuu yiri Prof. Alexandre Zabot, oo ah fiisigis yaqaan ka tirsan Jaamacadda Santa Catarina ee dalka Brazil. Qabow aad u daran Machadka boqortooyada UK u qaabilsan cilmiga xidigaha ee Greenwich wuxuu sheegay, haddii koonku uu sii ballaarto, in tamartiisu ay si aad ah u kala firdhi doonto, iyadoo xidigahana ay sii kala fogaan doonaan ilaa ugu dambayn ay dhici doonto in aanay xiddigo cusub dhalan doonin, xiddigaha jirana ay dabar go’i doonaan. Xaaladdaas waxaa loo yaqaan “Qabowga Weyn” ama “Dhammaadka kulaylka ee koonka”. Aragtidan waxay leedahay in ugu dambayn dhammaan atom-yada koonka ay gaari doonaan heer kuleylkoodu isku dheelitirmo, taasoo sababaysa in wax walba ay ku dhowaadaan in ay joojiyaan dhaqaaqa iyo isbeddelka. Sida aragtidani sheegtay, maalin maalmaha ka mid ah heerkulka adduunka oo dhan wuxuu noqon doonaa isku mid, kadibna wax walba si tartiib tartiib ah ayay u istaagi doonaan. Kala go”weyn Haddii rajadani aysan fiicneyn, waxaa jira aragti kale. Madxafka boqortooyada UK ee Greenwich sida ay sheegeen, aragtidani waxay ku salaysan tahay fikradda ah in koonku ku sii ballaaranayo xawaare sii kordhaya, taas oo ay waddo tamarta mugdiga ah. Haddii tani sii socoto, koonku wuxuu noqon karaa mid aad u xoog badan oo cufisjiidadku aysan awoodin in ay isku hayaan qaab-dhismeedka koonka. Cufisjiidadku wuxuu meerayaasha ku hayaa wareegga qorraxda, wuxuu dhulka ku hayaa meeshiisa, wuxuuna ka hortagaa in bini’aadamku ku lumaan hawada sare. Waa awoodda isku haysa nidaamyada sida xiddigaha, qorraxda, iyo waxyaabo kale. Tamarta mugdiga ah, waa arrin aad u dahsoon, waxayna u muuqataa in ay leedahay saameyn gabi ahaanba ka soo horjeedda. “Weli ma naqaan waxa ay ka samaysan tahay, laakiin waxaan ognahay in ay sababto nooc riixid ah, ama si ka duwan cufisjiidadka,” ayuu sheegay Prof. Zabot. NASA waxay sheegtay in tamarta mugdiga ahi ay sababeyso in koonku ku fido xawaare sii kordhaya. NASA waxay kaloo sheegtay in qiyaastii 68.3 ama ilaa 70 boqolkiiba in koonka oo dhan uu ka kooban yahay tamarta mugdiga ah. Arrintan waxaa markii ugu horreysay la ogaaday dabayaaqadii 1990-meeyadii. Aragtiyo kale Haddii tamarta mugdiga ahi daciifto oo ugu dambayn ay dib isu rogto, cufisjiidadku wuxuu dib u soo jiidi doonaa koonka. NASA waxay sheegaysaa in tani ay horseedi doonto xaalad keenaysa in koonku qarxo. Aragti kale waxay sheegaysaa in koonku mar kale isku laaban karo, kadibna “Big Bang” kale ay dhici karo, taasoo abuureysa koon cusub. Aragtidan waxaa loo yaqaan “Big Bounce”, taas oo sheegaysa in koonka iyo adduunyo kale ay jiri doonto. Xigashada Sawirka, Photo via Getty Images Ma la saadaalin karaa goorta adduunku dhammaan doono? “Ma jiraan wax cadeynaya in kala go’ weyn ama burbur uu dhici doono mustaqbalka” ayuu yiri Prof. Abramow. “Dadka qaar waxay qiyaasaan in dhammaadkani uu dhici doono dhowr tirilyan oo sano kaddib, halka kuwo kale ay sheegaan waqtiyo aad uga dheer,” ayuu hadalkiisa ku daray Prof. Zabot. Cilmi-baaris cusub oo ay soo saartay Jaamacadda Radboud ee Netherlands waxay soo jeedinaysaa in koonku uu sii burburayo oo sii yaraanayo si ka dhakhso badan sidii hore. Haddii koonku ugu yaraan jiro 13.8 bilyan oo sano, wali waxaa u harsan 986.2 bilyan oo sano si uu u gaaro hal tirilyan oo sano. “Xaqiiqdu waxay tahay in seynisku uu wax yar ka ogyahay koonka,” ayuu yiri Prof. Abramow. Qalabka xaddidan ee maanta aan haysanno ayaa adkeynaya in la sameeyo cabbirro sax ah. Source bbc somali

items.title: Maryan Qaasim oo UN kula wadaagtay xuquuqda aadanaha
items.description: Maryan Qaasim oo UN kula wadatay xuquuqda aadanaha Muqdisho, Arbaco, 20 Maajo 2026 – Guddoomiyaha Guddiga Madaxa-bannaan ee Xuquuqul Insaanka Qaranka Soomaaliyeed, Drs. Maryan Qaasim, ayaa maanta kulan ku qaadatay Brian James Williams, Madaxa Waaxda Maalgelinta Sanduuqa Dhismaha Nabadda ee Qaramada Midoobay (UN Peacebuilding), kaas oo diiradda lagu saaray xoojinta iskaashiga iyo taageerada horumarinta xuquuqda aadanaha iyo kobcinta hay’adaha qaran. Kulankan ayaa muhiimad weyn u leh Soomaaliya, iyadoo dalku uu ku jiro marxalad lagu dhisayo hay’adaha dawliga ah ka dib sanadaha dhaawaca. Sanduuqa Dhismaha Nabadda ee QM wuxuu taageero siiyaa dalalka soo koraya si loo xoojiyo cadaaladda, heshiisiinta bulshada, iyo ilaalinta xuquuqda aadanaha – waxyaabo aasaas u ah nabadda waarta. “Brian James Williams ayaa ku ammaanay guddiga dadaallada muuqda iyo waxqabadka ay soo bandhigeen muddadii koobnayd ee uu jiray,” ayay tiri Drs. Maryan Qaasim. “Wuxuu tilmaamay inay muujiyeen karti iyo dadaal wax ku ool ah oo lagu horumarinayo ilaalinta iyo dhowrista xuquuqda aadanaha.” Guddoomiyuhu waxa ay intaas ku dartay in Qaramada Midoobay ay aqoonsatay horumarka ay guddigu sameeyay muddo gaaban gudaheed, taas oo muujinaysa kalsoonida caalamku qabo hawsha guddiga. Dhankeeda, Guddoomiye Maryan Qaasim ayaa uga mahadcelisay martida booqashada ay ku yimaadeen xafiiska guddiga iyo taageerada joogtada ah ee Qaramada Midoobay. Waxa ay adkeysay muhiimadda ay leedahay wada-shaqeyn miro dhal ah oo lagu xoojinayo hawlaha guddiga iyo horumarinta xuquuqda aadanaha ee Soomaaliya. Waxa ay sheegtay in guddigu uu diyaar u yahay in uu la shaqeeyo QM si loo qorsheeyo barnaamijyo waxbarasho oo lagu wacyigelinayo xuquuqda aadanaha. Brian James Williams ayaa sheegay in sanduuqa UN Peacebuilding uu sii wadi doono taageerada guddiga, gaar ahaan dhinacyada awood-u-qaadista iyo kobcinta hay’adaha. Waxa kale oo uu soo jeediyay in la qabto tababarro wadajir ah oo loogu talagalay xubnaha guddiga si loo xoojiyo awooddooda dhinacyada kormeerka iyo warbixinta. Kulanka ayaa lagu soo gabagabeeyay iyadoo labada dhinac ay isku raaceen in la sii wado wadahadalka heer sare, iyadoo la filayo in guddigu uu soo jeediyay mashruuc cusub oo kaasho ka mid ah sanduuqa.

items.title: Xamsa oo soo dhaweeyay safiirka cusub ee Jabuuti
items.description: Xamsa oo soo dhaweeyay safiirka cusub ee Jabuuti Muqdisho, 20 May 2026 – Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Mudane Xamsa Cabdi Barre, ayaa maanta xafiiskiisa ku qaabilay Safiirka cusub ee Jamhuuriyadda Jabuuti u fadhiya Soomaaliya, Danjire Colonel Cusmaan Dubbad Sugulle, kaas oo dhawaan warqadaha aqoonsiga ka guddoomay Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya, iyadoo kulanka lagaga wada hadlay xoojinta xiriirka walaaltinimo ee labada dal. Kulankani wuxuu yimid iyadoo xiriirka Soomaaliya iyo Jabuuti uu yahay mid taariikhi ah oo ku salaysan iskaashi amni, dhaqaale iyo siyaasadeed. Jabuuti waxay ahayd mid ka mid ah dalalka ugu horreeyay ee garab istaaga Soomaaliya sanadihii dhibaatada, waxaana ay leedahay dano istiraatiiji oo ay ka wada shaqeyso sidii loo xasilin lahaa Geeska Afrika. Danjiraha cusub ayaa Ra’iisul Wasaaraha u gudbiyay salaan uu ka siday Madaxweynaha Jabuuti, Mudane Ismaaciil Cumar Geelle, isaga oo xusay in uu sii adkeeyn doono xiriirka soo jireenka ah ee ka dhexeeya labada dal. “Waxaan isugu tagay sidii aan sii xoojin lahaa walaaltinimada iyo iskaashiga u dhexeeya Soomaaliya iyo Jabuuti,” ayuu yiri Danjire Cusmaan Dubbad Sugulle. “Waxaan ka wada hadalnaa dhinacyada siyaasadda, amniga, iyo dhaqaalaha si loo gaaro faa’iido wadaag.” Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamsa ayaa ugu hambalyeeyay Danjiraha cusub xilka loo soo igmaday, isaga oo u rajeeyay guul. Waxa uu hoosta ka xarriiqay muhiimadda ay leedahay adkeynta xiriirka walaaltinimo iyo iskaashiga dhinacyada kala duwan. Waxa uu safiirka la wadaagay hambalyo uu u dirayo Ra’iisul Wasaaraha cusub ee Jabuuti, Mudane Cabdiqaadir Kaamil Maxamed. Ra’iisul Wasaaraha ayaa sheegay in Soomaaliya ay ka go’an tahay in la sii wado wadahadalka heer sare si loo xoojiyo isku xirnaanta, loona qaado tallaabooyin wax ku ool ah oo kor u qaadaya ganacsiga iyo maalgashiga. Danjiraha cusub ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in uu ballan qaaday in uu ka shaqeyn doono sidii loo fududeyn lahaa socdaalka muwaadiniinta labada dal.

items.title: Mukhalas weyn oo dadka si qarsoodi ah u tahriibiya oo la aqoonsaday
items.description: Mukhalas weyn oo dadka si qarsoodi ah u tahriibiya oo lagu aqoonsaday baaritaan ay samaysay BBC ayaa lagu xiray Kurdistaan Ciraaq. Shabakad uu maamulo Kardo Jaf, oo ku shaqeeya naanaysta Kardo Ranya, ayaa la rumeysan yahay inay sannadihii la soo dhaafay kumannaan muhaajiriin sharci-darro ah ku gudbisay doonyo yaryar iyaga oo uga gudbaya Kanaalka Ingiriiska kuna sii jeeda UK. Waxaa loo xiray tuhunsanaan dambiyo la xiriira ka ganacsiga dadka, waxaana qabtay ciidamada Hay’adda Amniga Gobolka Kurdistaan, wuxuuna weli ku jiraa xabsi iyadoo baaritaannadu socdaan. Ninkan 28 jirka ah ee Kurdiga Ciraaqiga ah ayaa dhowr sano ku shaqeynayay magacyo kala duwan oo been abuur ah. Isagoo magaciisa dhabta ah si adag u qariyay, Jaf wuxuu ka dhigay mid ku adag hay’adaha fulinta sharciga inay soo saaraan waaran caalami ah oo lagu soo xiro. Markii BBC ay la kulantay una gudbisay eedeymahan, Jaf wuu diiday inuu yahay tahriibiye, wuxuuna sheegay inuu kaliya dadka talo siiyay sida ay uga bixi karaan Ciraaq. Sidoo kale wuxuu sheegay inuusan aaminsanayn inuu wax dembi ah galay. Jaf waxaa lagu tuhunsan yahay inuu yahay shakhsi muhiim ah oo ka tirsan shabakad Ciraaqi Kurdi ah oo sanadihii la soo dhaafay maamuleysay inta badan safarrada sharci-darrada ah ee laga gudbo Kanaalka Ingiriiska. Inta badan waxaa lagu yaqaannay – labadaba muhaajiriinta iyo tahriibayaasha kale u yaqaanneen – naanaysta Kardo Ranya. Magaca dambe waxaa laga soo qaatay magaalada ku taal Kurdistaan Ciraaq ee isaga iyo hoggaamiyeyaasha kale ee shabakadda ay ka soo jeedaan. Tani waa shabakad awood leh oo dhammaanteed ku xirnaanaysa Ranya,” ayuu BBC u sheegay Dr. Muthana Nader, oo ah xildhibaan Kurdi ah. Wuxuuna intaas ku daray inuu rumeysan yahay in 70% tahriibka sharci-darrada ah ee lagu tago UK laga maamulo magaaladaas. Sida lagu diiwaangeliyay podcast-ka, Jaf wuxuu adeeggiisa ku xayeysiin jiray baraha bulshada, isagoo bixinayay adeeg tahriibin dad oo daboolaya masaafada ka bilaabata Afghanistan ilaa UK. Xayeysiisyadiisa waxay ka koobnaayeen sawirro soo jiidasho leh oo London ah iyo marqaatiyo ka yimid macaamiil u muuqday kuwo ku qanacsan. Sidoo kale wuxuu bixin jiray doorashooyin kala duwan oo ku saabsan waddooyinka iyo qaababka safarka, iyadoo lagu saleynayo inta ay muhaajiriintu awoodaan inay bixiyaan. Markuu la hadlay turjubaan BBC ah oo iska dhigay qof danaynaya adeegga, Jaf wuxuu sheegay qiimo dhan £160,000 si uu qoys dhan ugu geeyo UK isagoo adeegsanaya duullimaad “VIP” ah oo tagaya Manchester. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, BBC waxay sidoo kale maqashay sheekooyinka qaar ka mid ah macaamiishiisa dhaqaale ahaan liita, kuwaas oo sheegay in lagu khasbay doonyo aad u ciriiri ah oo khatar badan habeenkii dambe, lagana tagay si ay iskood isu debbaraan ugana gudbaan Kanaalka Ingiriiska. Hay’adda Dambiyada Qaranka ee UK (NCA) ayaa Talaadadii ku dhawaaqday in tuhmane tahriibinta dadka ah la xiray 13-kii May, iyada oo aan la magacaabin Jaf. Agaasimaha Guud ee Hawlgallada, Rob Jones, ayaa sheegay in arrintani tahay “xarig aad u muhiim ah oo suuragal ah oo loo geystay shakhsi muddo baaritaan ku jiray oo ay wadeen hay’ado badan oo fulinta sharciga ah sababo la xiriira xiriirkiisa tahriibinta dadka.” Jones wuxuu sheegay in “aan la malayn karin in dadka noocan oo kale ah ee lagu soo bandhigay dukumeentiga (BBC) ay ka baxsan yihiin gacanteenna.” Wuxuu intaas ku daray in NCA ay hadda waddo in ka badan 100 baaritaan oo ku socda shabakado ama shakhsiyaal ku jira heerka ugu sarreeya ee dambiyada abaabulan ee socdaalka, oo ay ku jiraan kuwa ku sugan meelo kala duwan oo Bariga Dhexe iyo Afrika “halkaas oo ay horay u aaminsanaayeen inay ka shaqayn karaan iyaga oo aan wax ciqaab ah la kulmin.” Tan iyo 2020, safarrada doonyaha yaryar ayaa noqday habka ugu badan ee lagu ogaado dadka si sharci-darro ah ugu soo galaya UK. Ku dhowaad dhammaan dadka habkan ku yimaada waxay dalbadaan magangelyo, iyagoo sheegaya inaysan si nabad ah ugu noolaan karin dalalkoodii sababo la xiriira cadaadis ama rabshado. Sida uu dhigayo sharciga caalamiga ah, tani waxay la micno tahay in loo oggol yahay inay dalka sii joogaan inta la tixgelinayo codsigooda magangelyo. Ku dhowaad dhammaan dadka ka gudba Kanaalka Ingiriiska waa da’doodu ka yar tahay 40 sano. Ragga iyo wiilasha ayaa ka dhignaa ku dhowaad sagaal ka mid ah 10-kii qof ee doonyaha yaryar ku yimid intii u dhaxeysay 2018 iyo 2025.

Sida lagu diiwaangeliyay podcast-ka, Jaf wuxuu adeeggiisa ku xayeysiin jiray baraha bulshada, isagoo bixinayay adeeg tahriibin dad oo daboolaya masaafada ka bilaabata Afghanistan ilaa UK. Xayeysiisyadiisa waxay ka koobnaayeen sawirro soo jiidasho leh oo London ah iyo marqaatiyo ka yimid macaamiil u muuqday kuwo ku qanacsan. Sidoo kale wuxuu bixin jiray doorashooyin kala duwan oo ku saabsan waddooyinka iyo qaababka safarka, iyadoo lagu saleynayo inta ay muhaajiriintu awoodaan inay bixiyaan. Markuu la hadlay turjubaan BBC ah oo iska dhigay qof danaynaya adeegga, Jaf wuxuu sheegay qiimo dhan £160,000 si uu qoys dhan ugu geeyo UK isagoo adeegsanaya duullimaad “VIP” ah oo tagaya Manchester. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, BBC waxay sidoo kale maqashay sheekooyinka qaar ka mid ah macaamiishiisa dhaqaale ahaan liita, kuwaas oo sheegay in lagu khasbay doonyo aad u ciriiri ah oo khatar badan habeenkii dambe, lagana tagay si ay iskood isu debbaraan ugana gudbaan Kanaalka Ingiriiska. Hay’adda Dambiyada Qaranka ee UK (NCA) ayaa Talaadadii ku dhawaaqday in tuhmane tahriibinta dadka ah la xiray 13-kii May, iyada oo aan la magacaabin Jaf. Agaasimaha Guud ee Hawlgallada, Rob Jones, ayaa sheegay in arrintani tahay “xarig aad u muhiim ah oo suuragal ah oo loo geystay shakhsi muddo baaritaan ku jiray oo ay wadeen hay’ado badan oo fulinta sharciga ah sababo la xiriira xiriirkiisa tahriibinta dadka.” Jones wuxuu sheegay in “aan la malayn karin in dadka noocan oo kale ah ee lagu soo bandhigay dukumeentiga (BBC) ay ka baxsan yihiin gacanteenna.” Wuxuu intaas ku daray in NCA ay hadda waddo in ka badan 100 baaritaan oo ku socda shabakado ama shakhsiyaal ku jira heerka ugu sarreeya ee dambiyada abaabulan ee socdaalka, oo ay ku jiraan kuwa ku sugan meelo kala duwan oo Bariga Dhexe iyo Afrika “halkaas oo ay horay u aaminsanaayeen inay ka shaqayn karaan iyaga oo aan wax ciqaab ah la kulmin.” Tan iyo 2020, safarrada doonyaha yaryar ayaa noqday habka ugu badan ee lagu ogaado dadka si sharci-darro ah ugu soo galaya UK. Ku dhowaad dhammaan dadka habkan ku yimaada waxay dalbadaan magangelyo, iyagoo sheegaya inaysan si nabad ah ugu noolaan karin dalalkoodii sababo la xiriira cadaadis ama rabshado. Sida uu dhigayo sharciga caalamiga ah, tani waxay la micno tahay in loo oggol yahay inay dalka sii joogaan inta la tixgelinayo codsigooda magangelyo. Ku dhowaad dhammaan dadka ka gudba Kanaalka Ingiriiska waa da’doodu ka yar tahay 40 sano. Ragga iyo wiilasha ayaa ka dhignaa ku dhowaad sagaal ka mid ah 10-kii qof ee doonyaha yaryar ku yimid intii u dhaxeysay 2018 iyo 2025.

items.title: Jaamacadda Carabta oo digniin culus u dirtay Somaliland kadib qorshaha safaaradda Qudus
items.description: Qaahira (Caasimada Online) – Xoghayaha guud ee Jaamacadda Carabta Axmed Abuu Geyd oo bayaan culus soo saaray ayaa Somaliland uga digay in ay safaarad ka furato magaalada Qudus ee xoogga ay ku haysato Israa’iil, xilli xukuumadda Cirro ay ku dhawaaqday in safaarad ay ka furaneyso magaaladaas, taas oo ka dhigan inay u aqoonsatay caasimadda dowladda Israa’iil. Abuu Geyd ayaa sidoo kale arrintan ku tilmaamay mid bar-madow ku noqon doonta maamulka Somaliland oo horay aqoonsi uga helay Israa’iil. Sidoo kale, Xoghayaha guud ee Jaamacadda Carabta ayaa ka digay khatarta ka dhallan karta faragelinta Israa’iil ay ku hayso Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, waxaana uu cambaareeyay tallaabooyinka uu qaaday maamulkaas. Waxaa kale oo uu intaas ku daray in ay waajib tahay in aan lagu xadgudbin midnimada iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee Soomaaliya, wuxuuna soo jeediyay in dalalka caalamka meel fog ay ka istaagaan farogelintaas, sida uu hadalka u dhigay. Si kastaba, Israa’iil ayaa haatan qorsheyneyso in dhankeeda ay safaarad ka furato magaalada caasimada ah ee Hargeysa, sida uu shaaciyay Maxamed Xaaji, oo ah safiirka cusub ee Somaliland u qaabilsan Israa’iil. Waxaa kale oo uu tallaabadaas ku tilmaamay calaamad muujineysa “saaxiibtinimo sii xoogeysaneysa, ixtiraam wadajir ah iyo iskaashi istaraatiiji ah” oo dhexmaraya labada dhinac. Go’aanka ayaa yimid bilo kadib markii Israa’iil ay si rasmi ah ugu dhawaaqday inay Somaliland u aqoonsatay dal madax-bannaan. Tallaabadaas ayaa Israel ka dhigtay dalkii ugu horreeyey ee caalamka ka tirsan ee aqoonsi rasmi ah siiya Somaliland, oo tan iyo 1991 raadineysay aqoonsi caalami ah. The post Jaamacadda Carabta oo digniin culus u dirtay Somaliland kadib qorshaha safaaradda Qudus appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Fiqi oo ku hanjabay in dowladdu soo afjari doonto mucaaradka
items.description: Fiqi oo ku hanjabay in dowladdu soo afjari doonto mucaaradka Muqdisho, 20 May 2026 – Wasiirka Gaashaandhiga Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Mudane Axmed Macali Fiqi, ayaa caawa hadalo kulul ku weeraray mucaaradka isagoo sheegay in dowladdu diyaar u tahay in ay soo afjarto mucaaradka, balse aan loo baahnayn in hub la qaato, iyadoo uu intaas ku daray in mucaaradka aysan u qalmin isla markaana uusan jirin hal shakhsi oo u qalma kursiga Madaxweynaha. Hadalladan ayaa ka dhacay xilli uu Wasiir Fiqi ka qeybgalayay barnaamij looga hadlayay isgaarsiinta oo lagu qabtay Hoteel Jaziira ee Muqdisho. Waxay ka tarjumayaan xiisadda siyaasadeed ee ka taagan Soomaaliya, iyadoo dowladda iyo mucaaradka ay isku hayaan arrimo kala duwan oo khuseeya geeddi-socodka doorashooyinka iyo qaybinta awoodda. “Dowladdu waxay diyaar u tahay in ay soo afjarto mucaaradka, balse aan loo baahnayn in hub la qaato,” ayuu yiri Wasiir Fiqi. “Mucaaradka aysan u qalmin isla markaana uusan ku dhex jirin hal shakhsi uu u qalma kursiga Madaxweynaha.” Wasiirku waxa uu hadalkiisa ku adkeeyay in dowladda ay awood u leedahay in ay ka hortagto mucaaradka si nabad ah, isagoona ugu baaqay mucaaradka in ay ku soo laabtaan wadahadalka iyo heshiiska qaran. Hadallada Fiqi ayaa kiciyay falcelin kala duwan oo ka yimid dadweynaha iyo siyaasiyiinta. Qaar ayaa ku tilmaamay in ay yihiin kuwo dareenka kicinaya oo aan ku habboonayn wakhtigan xasaasiga ah, halka qaar kalena ay sheegeen in ay muujinayaan go’aanka dowladda ee ah in aan lagu tanaasulin amniga iyo xasilloonida dalka. Mucaaradka ayaan weli si rasmi ah uga jawaabin hadalladan, laakiin ilo isku dhow mucaaradka ayaa sheegay in ay u arkaan kuwo meel ka baxsan oo horseedi kara sii kordhinta xiisadda. Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa muddooyinkii u dambeeyay waxaa ka socday dadaallo lagu doonayo in lagu heshiiyo mucaaradka si loo qabto doorasho wada jir ah. Hadallada Fiqi ayaa laga yaabaa in ay saameeyaan dadaalladaas, iyadoo laga filayo in uu soo baxo caddeyn dheeri ah oo ka timaada xafiiska Ra’iisul Wasaaraha ama wasaaradda arrimaha dibadda.

items.title: Deni oo ka qaatay Mareykanka balanqaad amni iyo maalgashi
items.description: Puntland iyo Mareykanka oo xoojinaya iskaashiga Garoowe, 20 May 2026 – Madaxweynaha Dowladda Puntland, Mudane Siciid Cabdullaahi Deni, oo uu weheliyo Madaxweyne Ku-xigeenka Ilyaas Cismaan Lugatoor, ayaa maanta Qasriga Madaxtooyada ku qaabilay wafdi heer sare oo ka socda Dowladda Mareykanka, oo uu hoggaaminayo Ku-xigeenka Safiirka Mareykanka ee Soomaaliya, Justin Davis, iyo saraakiil ka tirsan Africom oo uu ka mid yahay Col. Shane Jones, iyadoo kulanka looga hadlay amniga, siyaasadda, maalgashiga iyo ka faa’iidaynta khayraadka dabiiciga ah ee Puntland. Kulankani wuxuu yimid xilli Puntland ay ka mid tahay gobolada ugu xasilloon Soomaaliya, iyadoo Mareykanku uu doonayo inuu ku taageero dagaalka ka dhanka ah argagixisada, gaar ahaan hawlgallada ka socda buuralayda Calmiskaad. Sidoo kale, waxaa laga wada hadlay xaaladda kala guurka ah ee dalka Soomaaliya iyo doorka Puntland. “Waxaan bogaadinayaa hawlgalada ciidamada Puntland ee ka dhanka ah argagixisada iyo guulaha ay ka gaareen buuralayda Calmiskaad,” ayuu yiri Ku-xigeenka Safiirka Mareykanka, Justin Davis. “Waxaan xusayaa horumarka iyo nabadgelyada ka jirta Puntland, waxaanan ballanqaadayaa taageerada Dowladda Mareykanka ee dhinacyada adkeynta amniga, baahinta adeegyada bulshada, iyo horumarinta dhaqaalaha.” Madaxweyne Deni ayaa sheegay in Puntland ay ka go’an tahay xoojinta xiriirka iskaashi ee Mareykanka gaar ahaan dhinacyada maalgashiga khayraadka dabiiciga ah, sida macdanta, kalluumeysiga, iyo shidaalka. Waxa uu intaas ku daray in taageerada Mareykanku ay muhiim u tahay si looga gudbo caqabadaha amniyeed loona horumariyo dhaqaalaha. Waxaa kulanka ka qaybgalay xubno ka mid ah Golaha Wasiirada, Agaasimaha Guud ee Madaxtooyada, iyo la-taliyeyaal Madaxweyne. Labada dhinac ayaa isku raacay in la sii wado wadahadalka heer sare, iyadoo la filayo in Mareykanku uu kordhiyo taageerada barnaamijyada horumarineed ee Puntland. Ku-xigeenka safiirka ayaa sheegay in Dowladda Mareykanku ay Puntland u aragto saaxiib istiraatiiji ah oo muhiim u ah xasilloonida Geeska Afrika. Dabayaaqadii, Madaxweyne Deni waxa uu u mahadceliyay Mareykanka taageerada joogtada ah, waxaanu ballan qaaday in Puntland ay sii wadi doonto iskaashiga dhinacyada amniga iyo horumarka dhaqaalaha.

items.title: RW Xamsa oo la kulmay Danjiraha cusub Jabuuti ee Soomaaliya
items.description: Muqdisho ( Raxanreeb Online) Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Xukuumadda Soomaaliya, Xamsa Cabdi Barre, ayaa xafiiskiisa ku qaabilay Safiirka cusub ee Jabuuti u fadhiya Soomaaliya, Danjire Cusmaan Dubbad Sugulle, kaas oo dhawaan warqadaha aqoonsiga danjirenimo uu ka guddoomay Madaxweynaha JFS, Mudane Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud. Danjiraha cusub ayaa Ra’iisul Wasaaraha u gudbiyay salaan uu ka siday Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Jabuuti, Mudane Ismaaciil Cumar Geelle, isaga oo xusay in uu sii adkeeyn doono xiriirka soo jireenka ah ee ka dhexeeya labada dal, kaas oo ku dhisan walaaltinimo iyo iskaashi. Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamsa ayaa ugu hambalyeeyay Danjiraha cusub xilka loo soo igmaday, isaga oo u rajeeyay guul iyo in uu sii xoojiyo xiriirka labada dal. Waxa uu sidoo kale hoosta ka xarriiqay muhiimadda ay leedahay adkeynta xiriirka walaaltinimo iyo iskaashiga dhinacyada siyaasadda, amniga iyo dhaqaalaha ee u dhexeeya labada dal. Ra’iisul Wasaaraha ayaa safiirka la wadaagay hambalyo uu u dirayo Ra’iisul Wasaaraha cusub ee Jabuuti Mudane Cabdiqaadir Kaamil Maxamed, isaga oo u rajeeyay guul iyo in uu Eebbe u fududeeyo shaqada culus ee markale loo igmaday. items.title: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada XFS oo shaacisay xilliga la qaadayo imtixaanka shahaadiga ah ee Dugsiga Sare

items.title: Xujeyda Soomaaliyeed oo ku banaan-baxay Mukhtaar Roobow kadib markii uu…
items.description: Makkah (Caasimada Onlinee) – Qaar kamid ah Xujeyda Soomaaliyeed ee ku sugan dalka Boqortooyada Sacuudi Carabiya ayaa maanta ku banaanbaxay Wasiirka Wasaaradda Awqaafta iyo Arrimaha Islaamka Soomaaliya, Sheekh Mukhtaar Roobow Cali (Abuu Mansuur), iyaga oo cabasho ka muujinayo adeeg xumo iyo in la dayacay. Muuqaal kooban oo si weyn ugu baahay baraha bulshada ayaa muujinayo Xujeyda oo ku xoomaya gaariga wasiirka, iyadoo mid kamid ah uu isku dhigay baabuurka, taas oo keentay in Roobow uu soo dago, kadibna uu sidaas ku dhageysto cabashadooda. Mid kamid ah Xujeyda oo kasoo muuqday Video-ga ayaa sheegay in la dajiyay goob ka fog Xajka, sidoo Kalena ay haysato gaadiid la’aan iyo cunto yari. “Baahi ayaa na hayso baabuur aan raacno maleh Xaramka waa naga fogyahay,” ayuu yiri mid kamid ah Xujeyda Soomaaliyeed oo ka hadlayay dhibaatada haysata. Sidoo kale, Xaaji kale ayaa sheegay in Soomaalida ay ku dayac yihiin magaalooyinka Sacuudiga, halka muwaadiniinta dalal kale ay haystaan daryeel iyo basas gaar ah oo ay raacaan. “Itoobiyaan 5 kun ayaa kasoo Xajisay bas ayay leeyihiin badar ayay leeyihiin, daawo ayay leeyihiin annaga maxaan ku waynay?” ayuu ku dooday muuwaadin kale oo Soomaaliyeed. Intaas kadib waxaa soo farogeliyay cabashadan Wasiirka Awqaafta iyo Arrimaha Islaamka ee Xukuumadda Soomaaliya oo ballan qaaday in si degdeg ah uu wax uga qaban doono arrintan, isaga oo sidoo kale tilmaamay inuu aad uga xun yahay xaaladda haysata Xujeyda Soomaaliyeed. Inkastoo ay soo baxeen sanadkan dal-daloolo ku aadan dhibaatooyin ay wajahayaan Xujeyda Soomaaliyeed ayaa haddana doorka Dowlad Federaalka wuxuu yahay inay daryeesha Xujeyda, kana war qabto safarkood, maadaama ay yihiin kuwa dhaqaalaha ugu badan looga qaado bixitaankooda. items.title: Ururka Jaamacadda Carabta oo ka horyimid xaafiiska ay Soomaaliland ka furanayso magaalada Quddus
items.description: Ururka Jaamacadda Carabta ayaa si adag uga hadlay wararka la xiriira in maamulka Somaliland uu qorsheynayo inuu xaafiis ka furto magaalada Barakaysan ee Quddus, gaar ahaan qaybta ay Israa’iil maamusho ee Bariga Qudus. Bayaan kasoo baxay xoghayaha guud ee Jaamacadda Carabta, Ahmed Aboul Gheit, ayaa lagu sheegay in tallaabadaasi ay tahay mid sharci darro ah, islamarkaana aan wax saameyn sharciyeed ah yeelan karin. Wuxuu ku tilmaamay arrintaasi kicin aan la aqbali karin oo ka dhan ah dunida Carabta iyo tan Islaamka, ayadoo Afhayeenka xoghayaha guud, Gamal Roshdy, uu asna sheegay in dhaq-dhaqaaqyada noocan oo kale ah ay muujinayaan sida ay Israa’iil u raadineyso aqoonsiyo cusub oo ay ka hesho maamulo ama gobollo aan si rasmi ah loo aqoonsanayn, si ay ugu xoojiso joogitaankeeda dhulka Falastiiniyiinta. Jaamacadda Carabta ayaa sidoo kale sheegtay in xiriir kasta oo lala yeesho maamul aan caalamku aqoonsanayn uu dhaawac ku yahay midnimada iyo madaxbannaanida Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya. Bayaanka ayaa sidoo kale digniin looga bixiyay waxa lagu tilmaamay fara-gelinta sii kordheysa ee Israa’iil ay ku sameyneyso Geeska Afrika, iyadoo lagu sheegay in arrintaasi ay kordhin karto xiisadaha iyo xasillooni darrada gobolka. Israa’iil ayaa dhowaan sheegtay in ay Soomaaliland xaafiis ka furanayso magaalada Quddus ka dib markii Madaxweynaha maamulka Israa’iil uu waraaqaha aqoonsiga ka guddoomay wakiil ay Soomaaliland dirsatay.

items.title: Xujeyda Soomaaliyeed oo cabasho ka muujiyay in la dejiyay meelo ka fog goobaha Cibaadada
items.description: Makka ( Raxanreeb Online) Qaar kamid ah Xujeyda Soomaaliyeed ee sannadkan u amba-baxay gudashada waajibaadka Xajka, ayaa la kulmay culeesyo ku aadan ageedyadii u baahnayeen si ay u gutaan waajibaadka Xajka. Xujeyda ayaa sheegay in la dejiyay deegaano ka fog goobaha muhiimka ah ee Xajka, taasi ku qabsatay in ay la kulmeen dhibaatooyin dhinaca gaadiidka iyo helitaanka ageegyada aas-aaska sida cunida iyo hooy wanaagsan. Waxa ay sheegeen xujeyda in adeegyada loo fidiyay ay aad u hooseyaan, marka loo eego lacagaha laga qaaday qofkii oo ah in ka badan afar kun oo dollar, taasi oo ka dhigeysa Soomaaliya meelaha ugu qaalisan ee lagu bixiyo kharashaadka Xajka. Sidoo kale maalintii shalay qaar kamid ah xujeyda ayaa dhigay banaanbax cabasho ah iyaga ooh or istaagay gaari uu la socday wasiir Awqaafta iyo arrimaha Islaamka Muqtaar Roboow, iyaga oo ka dalbanaya inuu wax ka qabto xaaladaha ay wajahayaan. Ilaa iyo hadda ma jiro war kasoo baxay wasaaradda oo ku aadan cabashooyinka ay gudbiyeen xujeeyda Soomaaliyeed, ee sannadkan gudanaya waajibaadka Xajka. items.title: Saraakiishii ugu badneyd oo ku sii qulqulaya Baydhaba
items.description: Baydhabo (Caasimada Online) – Magaalada Baydhabo ee xarunta gobolka Baay waxaa haatan kusii qulqulayo saraakiil ka tirsan Ciidamada Xoogga Dalka kuwaas oo ka qayb-qaadanaya howlaha sugidda amniga ee magaaladaasi. Kaaliyaha Taliska Xoogga Dalka, Janaraal Maadey Nuurey Sheekh ayaa maanta gaaray Baydhabo, iyadoo garoonka diyaaradaha Shaati Gaduud ay kusoo dhaweeyeen Kaaliyaha Taliska Dhulka Jeneraal Cabdullahi Aadan Xuseen (Cirro) iyo saraakiil kale oo ka tirsan qaybta 60-aad ee Ciidamada Xoogga. Ujeedka saraakiishan oo ka baxay Muqdisho ayaa ah inay kaalintooda ka qaataan xoojinta amniga magaalada oo lagu qabanayo doorashada gudoonka Golaha Wakiilada iyo Madaxweynaha cusub ee Koonfur Galbeed Soomaaliya. Sidoo kale, Janaraal Maadey Nuurey ayaa lagu wadaa inuu qayb ka noqdo kulamada ka socda magaalada ee looga hadlayo xasilinta iyo howlaha doorashooyinka, maadaama uu socdo diyaar garowgii ugu dambeeyay. Baydhabo, waxaa haatan ku sugan ciidamo isugu jira qaybta Taliska 60-aad, Kumaandooska Gorgor iyo kuwo Booliis ah, iyada oo sidoo kale la kordhiyay goobaha hubinta gaadiidka ee gudaha iyo bannaanka magaaladaas. Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa xoogga saareysa arrimaha Koonfur Galbeed, waxayna sidoo kale shalay taliyaha cusub ee guutada 8-aad, qeybta 60-aad ee Ciidamada Xoogga Dalka u magacowday Gaashaanle Dhexe Cabdulle Isaaq Ibraahim oo horay u ahaa taliyihii Booliska ee degmada Wanlaweyn. Magacaabistan ayaa timid kadib markii dhawaan duleedka Baydhabo ay Al-Shabaab ku dileen ku-simihii taliyaha qeybta 60-aad, Gaashaanle Sare Yoonis Aadan & taliyihii guutada 8-aad ee qeybta 60 ee Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed Cali Caddow, kadib weerar dhabo gal ah oo si kadis ah ugu qabsaday halkaas. The post Saraakiishii ugu badneyd oo ku sii qulqulaya Baydhaba appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Somali pilgrims protest over Hajj conditions despite high fees
items.description: Somali pilgrims performing Hajj in Saudi Arabia have complained of poor accommodation and inadequate services despite paying more than $4,000 each for the journey, among the highest Hajj costs in the region. Several pilgrims said they were housed far from key religious sites, forcing them to endure long travel times and difficulties accessing transport, food and other basic services during the pilgrimage. The complaints escalated this week after some pilgrims staged a protest, accusing organisers of mismanagement and demanding answers over the deteriorating conditions. The controversy has renewed scrutiny over Somalia’s Hajj arrangements, with critics questioning why pilgrims continue to face recurring hardships despite the high prices charged annually. Somali authorities have not yet publicly responded to the growing backlash.

items.title: Somaliland, Israel Move to Open Embassies in Jerusalem and Hargeisa
items.description: The government of Somaliland says it plans to open an embassy in Jerusalem, while Israel is expected to establish diplomatic representation in Hargeisa in what officials describe as a major step in growing ties between the two sides. Mohamed Hagi, Somaliland’s envoy to Israel, announced the move on Tuesday, saying the decision reflects “growing friendship, mutual respect and strategic cooperation” between both peoples. Israeli Foreign Minister Gideon Saar welcomed the announcement, calling it a significant milestone in strengthening bilateral relations and saying both governments would work to implement the plan soon. The development follows Israel’s decision last December to officially recognize Somaliland’s independence, becoming the first country to do so after more than three decades of Somaliland’s push for international recognition. The recognition sparked criticism from the United Nations Security Council, the African Union, the Organisation of Islamic Cooperation and the European Union. Somaliland declared independence from Somalia in 1991, though Mogadishu continues to reject the move and considers the region part of Somalia. The proposed embassy in Jerusalem would place Somaliland among a small group of countries and territories with diplomatic missions in the contested city, whose status remains central to the decades-long Israeli-Palestinian conflict.

items.title: Wasiirka dhalinyarada oo Turkiga kula qeyb galay xuska 19ka May – Atatürk uu u hibayay dhalinyarada
items.description: Wasiirka dhalinyarada oo ka qeyb galay xuska 19ka May Muqdisho, 20 May 2026 – Wasiirka Wasaaradda Dhallinyarada iyo Isboortiga Soomaaliya, Mudane Maxamed Cabduqaadir Cali, ayaa maanta ka qeyb galay munaasabad lagu xusayay 19-ka May oo ah Maalinta Dhalinyarada iyo Isboortiga Turkiga, taas oo ka dhacday Safaaradda Turkiga ee Muqdisho, isaga oo uga hambalyeeyay dhalinyarada Turkiga kuna xusay in ay maalintani la mid tahay 15-ka May oo ah Maalinta Dhallinyarada Soomaaliyeed ee SYL. Xuskani wuxuu muhiimad gaar ah u leeyahay xiriirka labada dal, maadaama Turkiga iyo Soomaaliya ay wadaagaan taariikh iyo dhaqamo dhow. 19-kii May 1919-kii ayaa Mustafa Kemal Atatürk, aasaasihii Jamhuuriyadda Turkiga, gaaray magaalada Samsun oo ka bilowday halgankii xorriyadda iyo aasaaskii Turkiga casriga ah. Atatürk wuxuu maalintan u hibayay dhalinyarada, taas oo sanad walba loo dabaaldego Maalinta Dhalinyarada iyo Isboortiga. “Waxaan u hambalyeeyay shacabka Turkiga, gaar ahaan dhalinyarada, maalintan muhiimka ah,” ayuu yiri Wasiir Maxamed Cabduqaadir Cali. “19-ka May waa maalin qaran oo Turkiga uga dhigan tahay bilowga xorriyadda, sida 15-ka May oo ay Soomaaliya ugu dabaaldegtay halgankii SYL ee xornimada.” Wasiirku waxa uu intaas ku daray in dhalinyarada labada dal ay door muhiim ah ka ciyaaraan kobcinta xiriirka iskaashiga, isagoo ku boorriyay in ay ka faa’iidaystaan fursadaha waxbarasho iyo isboorti ee ay bixiyaan dowladaha. Munaasabadda waxaa ka qeyb galay dhalinyaro Soomaaliyeed oo intooda badan waxbarasho ku qaatay dalka Turkiga, iyo sidoo kale mas’uuliyiin ka socotay Safaaradda Turkiga. Safiirka Turkiga ee Soomaaliya ayaa sheegay in Turkigu uu sii wadi doono taageerada dhalinyarada Soomaaliyeed ee waxbarashada, isboortiga, iyo tababarka xirfadaha nolosha. Dhalinyarada Soomaaliyeed ee ka soo qayb gashay munaasabadda ayaa sheegtay in ay dareemayaan farxad ay ku xusayaan maalinta qaranka Turkiga, iyagoo u mahadceliyay dowladda Turkiga deeqda waxbarasho ee ay siisay qaar badan oo iyaga ka mid ah. items.title: Soomaaliya oo taariikhiga ugu horeysay ka qayb gelaysa isreeb-reebka AFCON 2027
items.description: Soomaaliya oo taariikhda ku qortay isreeb-reebka AFCON 2027 Qaahira, Masar – 20 May 2026 – Xiriirka Kubadda Cagta Afrika (CAF) ayaa maanta si rasmi ah u shaaciyay isku qaybinta isreeb-reebka heerka kooxaha ee tartanka Qaramada Afrika (AFCON 2027), iyadoo Soomaaliya ay markii ugu horreysay taariikhdeeda ka mid noqotay 48-ka xul ee ka qayb galaya guruubyada, waxaana loo dhigay Group C oo ay weheliyaan Côte d’Ivoire, Ghana, iyo Gambia. Munaasabad weyn oo ka dhacday magaalada Qaahira ee dalka Masar ayaa lagu qabtay qeybinta, iyadoo ay ka qeyb galay mas’uuliyiin ka tirsan CAF iyo wafuud ka socotay dalalka qeyb ka ah tartanka, oo ay ku jiraan wafdi ka socday Xiriirka Kubadda Cagta Soomaaliya (SFF). Tartanka AFCON 2027 ayaa si wadajir ah u martigelin doona Kenya, Tanzania, iyo Uganda – markii ugu horreysay oo seddex dal ay wada qabtaan caleemaha Afrika. Soomaaliya oo ah xulka loo yaqaan ‘Ocean Stars’ ayaa kaga guulaysatay inay soo baxdo marxaladdan shirka kadib markii ay soo martay wareegyo isreeb-reeb oo adag. Kooxaha guruubka kala horreeya waxay ciyaari doonaan laba xul oo ugu sarreeya, kuwaas oo u soo bixi doona tartanka ugu dambeeya oo ka koobnaan doona 24 xul. Group C waxaa intaas dheer lagu qirayaa inuu yahay mid adag, maadaama Côte d’Ivoire ay tahay horyaalkii laba jeer (1992 iyo 2015), Ghana ay tahay xul caalami ah, Gambia-na ay soo martay horumar weyn. “Waa guul taariikhi ah inaan markii ugu horreysay gaarnay heerkan guruubyada,” ayuu yiri Xoghayaha Guud ee Xiriirka Kubadda Cagta Soomaaliya oo ka hadlay munaasabadda Qaahira. “Waan ognahay in guruubkeenu yahay mid adag, laakiin Ocean Stars waxay diyaar u yihiin inay si sharaf leh u matalaan dalkooda oo ay muujiyaan horumarkii ay kordheen.” Mas’uulka SFF ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in xulka Soomaaliya uu tababaro xoojinayo looguna talagalay in looga qayb galo tartankan ugu weyn Afrika, isagoo u mahadceliyay dadweynaha Soomaaliyeed taageeradooda. Tartanka AFCON 2027 wuxuu si rasmi u bilaaban doonaa 19-ka Juun 2027, iyadoo finalka lasoo gabagabeynayo 17-ka Luulyo 2027. 48-ka xul ayaa loo qeybiyay 12 guruub oo afar xul midkiiba ka kooban yahay. Labada xul ee ugu sarreeya guruub kasta ayaa usoo gudbaya wareegga 24-xul. Wafdiga Soomaaliya oo ka soo laabtay Qaahira ayaa sheegay in la qorsheeyay in la qabto qaab diyaar garow oo dheer si looga soo horjeedo xulalada waaweyn.

items.title: Dhadhaab: Dhallinyaro qaxooti ah oo hirgaliyay ganacsiyo beddelay noloshooda
items.description: (ERGO) – In ka badan 500 oo ah dhalinyaro ka soo jeeda qoysas qaxooti ku ah xeryaha Dhadhaab ayaa ku filnaaday nolosha reerahooda. Arrintaas aya timid, markii dhaqaale ka heleen ganacsiyo yar yar oo 6 bil ee la soo faadhay ay ku furteen lacago ay sanado aruurinayeen. Aadan Jimcaale Xasan oo ka mid ah wuxuu dukaan lagu iibiyo waxyaabaha electroniga, xawaalad iyo bagaashka ka furtay bishiii Nofeember ee sanadkii hore dulleedka xerada Dhagaxley. Goobaha ganacsiga oo ku yar meesha uu ka hirgaliyay ayaa sababtay inuu macaamiil badan helo. Wuxuu sheegay in uu si maalinlaha uga helo 800 illa 1000 shilin oo ugu filan nolosha qoyskiisa oo ka kooban 7 ah. Ninkaan ayaa xusay in ay horray u wajahayeen nolol xumo ay xal u la’aayeen, hasa ahaate ay hadda heleen soo kabasho nololeed. “Wax badan ayaa iska beddelay nolosha qoskayga. Waxaan u awooday cunno joogta ah, caafimaadkooda, waxbarasho iyo inaan kayd lahaado oo aan meel wax dhigto. Aad ayaan ugu faraxsanahay inaan helay xoriyad dhaqaale.” Aadan ayaa sheegay in ka hor ganacsiga ay qoyskiisu ku tiirsanayeen kaalmo raashin ah oo ay ka halayeen hay’adaha gargaarka ee xeryaha iyo 15 kun oo shilin oo ahayd mushaar uu ka qaadan jiray dukaan uu ka shaqayn jiray.    Ninkaan oo curad u ah reerkiisa ayaa sheegay in ganacsigiisa uu ku billabay 6 illa 7 kun oo uu bil walbo meel ka dhigi jiray mushaarkiisa in ka badan afar sano. Waxay u gaartay 200 oo kun, taas oo u sahashay inuu milkiile noqdo. Dhaqaalaha uu ka helaya ganacsigiisa ayaa suuragaliyay in qoyskiisa uu ka xaliyo culays ka haystay hoyga. Wuxuu bishii Febraayo u dhisay qol jingad ah oo ay uga raysteen buush ay horray ugu noolaayeen. Wuxuu xusay in ay uga baxday 70,000 oo shilinka kenya ah.  Ninkaan oo 28 jir ayaa ku taamaya inuu sii balaariyo ganacsigiisa sanadaha soo socda. Wuxuu naawilaya inuu shaqo abuur u sameeyo dhalinyaro kale. “Waxaan ku haminaya inaan aniga noqda qofka keena ee laga sii qaadan doonna. Nolosha qoyskaga inaan sii hormariya ayaan sidoo kale rajaynaya.” Aadan ayaa sheegay in mudaadii uu shaqaynayay ay u suuragashay inuu waxbarasho ku daro gabar uu dhalay oo horray aan wax baran jirin. Wuxuu bishii ka dhiba 1,500 oo shilin oo ah kharashka ay dugsi Qur’aan iyo iskuulka ku dhigato. Wuxuu xusay in sababta uusan horray ugu gayn ay ahayd inuu u tabaabushaysanayay sidii uu u billaabi laha ganacsi uu milkiyaadiisa leeyahay, taas oo uu hadda u suuragashay.  Labo carruur ah oo uusan wali gayn ayuu sidoo kale ku haminaya inuu ku daro bilaha soo aadan. Wuxuu dhanka kale sheegay inuu bil walbo uu kayd ahaan u dhigto 6,000 oo shilin. Lacagtan ayuu tilmaamay in u qorshayay inuu ku soo balaariyo ganacsigiisa marka ay u aruurto. Ninkaan ayaa sanadkii 2018 dhameeyay dugsiga sare ee xerada Dhagaxley, taas oo ka caawinaysa inuu ganacsigiisa maareeyo. Fursadan ganacsi ayuu sheegay in ay sabab u noqotay inuu ka baqsado tahriib ay aadeen dhalinyaro badan oo saxiibadii ah. Qoyska Aadan oo xoola dhaqato ahaa ayaa sanadkii 1998 amni daro ka jirtay xilligaas uga soo barakacay miyiga magaalada Kismaayo ee gobolka Jubbada hoose. Dhamaan dadka samaystay ganacsiyada ayaa kala siman faa’iido ay mahdiyeen. Xirfadaha gacanta ayaa ka mid waxyabaha caawiyay in ay dhalinyarada qaarkood ay ku dhiiradan ganacsiyo u gaar ah. Cabdulqaadir Axmed Cumar wuxuu dukaan dharka lagu iibiyo laguna tolo ku furtay xerada Xagardheer. Waxaa u sahashay ugu yaraan 10 kun oo shilin oo uu ka aruuriyay 15 kun oo ah mushaar uu ka qaadan jiray dukaan uu shaqaale ka ahaa. Wuxuu xusay muddo shan sano ah oo uu waday in ay u gaartay 600,000. Ganacsigiisa oo yeeshay macaamiil badan ayuu xusay inuu joogta uga helo 1,000 shilin oo ah lacagta kenya. Dhaqaalahan ayaa sababay inuu si buuxda u maareeyo nolosha qoyskiisa oo 10 ah. Wuxuu xusay in horray ay dabka shidan jireen mar iyo labo ay tashiisaan waxa ay helaan, balse ay hadda awoodeen saddexda waqti. “Ilmahayga, waalidkayga iyo walaalahay ba aniga ayay igu tiirsan yihiin. ma jirto meel kale oo ay wax naga soo galaan oo aan ka ahayn ganacsigayga.” Cabdulqaadir ayaa sheegay in uu ka baaqsaday shan kun oo shilin oo uga bixi lahayd kirada dukaanka iyo lacagta koronta. Wuxuu xaruntiisa ku billabay qol ka mid ah gurigooda, halka korontana uu uga maarmay soolarka cadceeda ku shaqeeya oo uu soo iibsaday. Wuxuu xusay in ganacsigiisi ay fursad shaqo ka heleen dhalinyaro kale. Waxaa la shaqeeya afar rag ah oo uu maalinkii siiyo 3 boqol illa 5 boqol oo shilin.  Wuxuu xusay in uu ku soo xushay daruufta nololeed ee qoysaskooda iyo shaqo la’aan haysay. Wuxuu sidoo kale si joogta ah farsamada gacanta u baraa dhalinyaro iskugu jira gabdho iyo wiilal. Wuxuu xusay in saddexdii bil ee la soo dhaafay uu tababar siisay sideed dhalinyaro ah oo hadda xirfaddooda kusha shaqaysta suuqyada xeryaha. Dedaalkii uu ku bixiyay inuu isku filnaan gaara oo mira dhal noqday ayuu xusay inuu ku faraxsan yahay. “Baahiyo badan ayaan ka xaliyay oo ay ugu horayso inaan nolosha ilmahayga ka maareyay. Alxamdullilah Illahey mooye cid igu garab siisay malahan.” Lixdii bil ee la soo dhaafay waxaa xeryaha Dhadhaab ku soo badanayay dhalinyarada ganacsiyada gaarka u ah aas-aasanaya sida uu Raadiyow Ergo u sheegayMaxamed Cabdullaahi Jimcaale oo ah gudoomiyaha urrurada dhalinyarada xerada Xagardheer. Wuxuu xusay in in ka badan 500 goobo ganacsi ay ka hirgaleen mudadan xeryaha, waxaana fursado shaqo ka helay ku dhawaad 600 oo qof. “Dhalinyarada saamaynta ugu badan waxaa ku yeeshay shaqooyinkii ay hay’adaha ka heli jireen oo meesha ka baxay. Dhaqaale xumada dunida ka jirta qaxootiga waa saamaysay oo sidii deeqaha loo heli jiray hadda looma helo. Wax walbana gababsi ayay noqdeen. Talaabooyinka ay dhalinyarada qaadeen waxay ahaayeen lagama marmaan.” Hal-abuurrada ganacsi ee dhalinyaradu ay la yimaadeen ayaa u muuqda kuwa u keeni doonna isku filnaan dhaqaale oo waara, taas oo meesha ka saaraysa nolol xumada haysa qoysaska barakacay. Wuxuu xusay in in ka badan 500 goobo ganacsi ay ka hirgaleen mudadan xeryaha, waxaana fursado shaqo ka helay ku dhawaad 600 oo qof. “Dhalinyarada saamaynta ugu badan waxaa ku yeeshay shaqooyinkii ay hay’adaha ka heli jireen oo meesha ka baxay. Dhaqaale xumada dunida ka jirta qaxootiga waa saamaysay oo sidii deeqaha loo heli jiray hadda looma helo. Wax walbana gababsi ayay noqdeen. Talaabooyinka ay dhalinyarada qaadeen waxay ahaayeen lagama marmaan.” Hal-abuurrada ganacsi ee dhalinyaradu ay la yimaadeen ayaa u muuqda kuwa u keeni doonna isku filnaan dhaqaale oo waara, taas oo meesha ka saaraysa nolol xumada haysa qoysaska barakacay. items.title: Shiinaha iyo Ruushka oo heshiisyadii ugu badnaa kala saxiixday
items.description: Dowladaha Shiinaha iyo Ruushka, ayaa hadda saxiixay bayaan wadajir ah oo ku saabsan xoojinta isku-dubaridka istaraatiijiyadeed ee u dhexeeya Shiinaha iyo Ruushka, iyo “xoojinta iskaashiga saaxiibtinimo iyo deris wanaagga”. Waxaa la filayaa inay hadda saxiixaan 20 dukumenti oo dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan arrimo kale oo badan, oo ay ku jiraan heshiisyada iskaashiga ganacsiga iyo tignoolajiyada. Mas’uuliyiin ka kala socda Shiinaha iyo Ruushka ayaa kala saxiixday heshiisyo taxane ah, oo ku saabsan dhinacyada ganacsiga, tignoolajiyada, ganacsiga la xirriira garaadka iyo cilmi-baarista sayniska. Madaxweynaha Ruushka, Vladimir Putin iyo dhgiisa Shiinaha, Xi Jinping ayaa ku kulmay magaalada Beijing ee Shiinaha. Booqashada Putin ee Shiinaha waxay imaaneysa maalmo un kadib markii madaxweynaha Mareykanka, Donald Trump uu safar ku tegay dalka Shiinaha. Vladimir Putin ayaa u sheegay Xi, in xirriirka labada dal u gaaray heer aad u sarreeya oo aan horey loo arag. The post Shiinaha iyo Ruushka oo heshiisyadii ugu badnaa kala saxiixday appeared first on Raxanreeb Online .

items.title: Waa sidee? Wasiirka Hawlaha Guud ee Soomaaliya iyo GCC oo Baku ku dhawaaqay iskaashi cusub oo dib-u-dhiska dalka beddeli kara
items.description: Wasiirka Hawlaha Guud ee Soomaaliya oo Baku kula kulmay Xoghayaha GCC Baku, 19-May-2026 – Wasiirka Wasaaradda Hawlaha Guud, Dib-u-dhiska iyo Guriyeynta XFS, Mudane Xildhibaan Ayuub Ismaciil Yuusuf, ayaa magaalada Baku ee dalka Azerbaijan kulan muhiim ah la yeeshay Xoghayaha Guud ee Golaha Iskaashiga Dalalka Khaliijka Carabta (GCC), Jaasim Maxamed Al-Budaywi, iyadoo kulanku qayb ka ahaa Shirka Madasha Caalamiga ah ee Magaalooyinka Adduunka. Kulankan ayaa diiradda lagu saaray sidii loo xoojin lahaa iskaashiga u dhexeeya Soomaaliya iyo dalalka GCC-da, gaar ahaan dhanka horumarinta magaalooyinka, kaabayaasha dhaqaalaha, dib-u-dhiska iyo horumarka waara, taas oo muhiim u ah dib-u-heshiisiinta dalka kaas oo sanado badan soo food saarayay colaado iyo abaaro dabiici ah. Xiisadda Soomaaliya u qabto iskaashiga GCC-da Kulanku wuxuu yimid xilli ay Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya si weyn ugu tiirsan tahay kaalinta dalalka Khaliijka Carabta ee taageerada dib-u-dhiska kaabayaasha dalka. Wasiir Ayuub Ismaciil Yuusuf ayaa kulanka ku adkeeyay in Dowladda Soomaaliya ay mudnaan sare siinayso xiriirka ay la leedahay dalalka GCC-da. “Waxaan aaminsanahay in iskaashiga ay Soomaaliya la yeelato dalalka GCC-da uu hormuud ka yahay sidii loo dhisayay kaabayaasha muhiimka ah ee dalka uma baahan yahay, gaar ahaan warshadaha, iskuulka, cusbitaalada iyo jidadka,” ayuu yiri Wasiir Ayuub, isagoo intaas ku daray in Soomaaliya ay furan tahay maalgashiyada laga sameeyo dhinacyada kala duwan. Xoghayaha Guud ee GCC, Jaasim Maxamed Al-Budaywi, ayaa sheegay in Goluhu diyaar u yahay inuu Soomaaliya kala shaqeeyo qorshayaasha horumarinta magaalooyinka iyo dib-u-dhiska, isagoo tilmaamay in danaha wadajirka ahi ay yihiin kuwa dhowaaneed oo ay suurtogal tahay in si dhakhso leh loo hirgeliyo. Kulankan oo lagu soo dhammeeyey is-afgarad wax ku ool ah ayaa waxaa uu daba socdaa shir ay maalintii hore wasiirku kaga qayb galay madasha caalamiga ah, halkaas oo uu ka warbixiyay qorshayaasha Soomaaliya ee ku aaddan dib-u-dhiska kaabayaasha.

items.title: Mucaaradka oo sheegay in Xasan SHeekh uu ciidamo cusub diyaarsaday  + Video
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Xildhibaan Cabdiraxmaan Cabdishakuur Warsame oo kamid ah xubnaha siyaasiyiinta mucaaradka ayaa ku eedeeyay Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud inuu abaabulayo ciidamo cusub oo uu sheegay inuu u diyaarsaday inuu ku caburiyo mucaaradka kasoo horjeedo. Warsame ayaa shaaca ka qaaday inay la socdaan ciidamo lagu tababaray gobollada dhexe iyo guutooyin kale oo u xareysan Xasan Sheekh, isla markaana uu doonaayo inuu soo saaro, si uu ugu adeegsado danihiisa siyaasadeed, sida uu hadalka u dhigay. “Waxaan ognahay in Xasan Sheekh uu wado abaabul ciidan wuxuu soo wadaa ciidan lagu tababaray gobollada dhexe, guutooyin cusub oo u xareysan inuu lasoo baxaayo ayaan ognahay kuwa TurkSom ugu xareysan inuu lasoo baxaayo ayaan ognahay,” ayuu yiri Xildhibaan Cabdiraxmaan Cabdishakuur. Waxaa kale oo uu kusii daray “Ujeedkiisa waxaa waayay inuu dhiigeyna ku baneysto taas waa inay dadka ogaadaan, laakiin annaga ka tanaasuleyno Madaxweynihii ka horreyayna ciidan ugama aanan cabsanin asigana ciidan ugama cabsaneyno”. Ra’iisul wasaarihii hore ee Soomaaliya, Xasan Cali Khayre ayaa dhankiisa farriin u diray ciidamada qalabka sida, wuxuuna ugu baaqay in aysan dhibaateyn dadka shacabka ah, sidoo kalena aysan qaadan amarrada madaxa joogta Villa Somalia. “Ninka fadhiya Villa Somalia waa Madaxweynihii hore ha qaadanina amar la idin siinaayo inaad Ummadda Soomaaliyeed ku dhibaateysaan waxaa la idin tababaray inaad Ummadda Soomaaliyeed difaacdaan ilaalisaan nabadda dalka dhowrtaan sharafta iyo karaamada shacabka”, ayuu yiri Xasan Cali Khayre. Dhinaca kale, ma jiro wax hadal ah oo kasoo baxay Villa Somalia oo ku aadan eedda mucaaradka ee ku aadan ciidamadaas la sheegay inay abaabulayaan. Si kastaba, mucaaradka ayaa haatan wada dhaq-dhaqaaqyo ka dhan ah Madaxweynaha, iyaga oo iclaamiyay dibad-baxyo horleh oo 4-ta June ka dhacaya Muqdisho, kuwaas oo ay tilmaameen in todobaadyo socon doonaan. The post Mucaaradka oo sheegay in Xasan SHeekh uu ciidamo cusub diyaarsaday + Video appeared first on Caasimada Online .
