items.title: How Abdirizak Haji Hussein Would Read the Constitutional Crisis and Governance Failures in Somalia Today
items.description: By Anwar Maxamed Diiriye “A great leader is not remembered for the power they held, but for the principles they refused to abandon.” — Anonymous The unfolding constitutional crisis in Somalia once again exposes the deep fragility of national governance and the growing erosion of trust between the federal government and the federal member states. What we are witnessing is not merely a political disagreement, but a reflection of weakened institutions, persistent corruption, and the long-term consequences of repeated leadership failures. Too often, segments of Somalia’s political elite abandon their fundamental duty as public servants. Instead of strengthening trusted and well-established public institutions, they resort to power consolidation, constitutional manipulation, and practices shaped by the legacy of civil war politics. This pattern has become painfully predictable with every electoral cycle bringing renewed tension, legal overreach, and deliberate distortions of the constitutional framework. Each administration, rather than respecting institutional limits, attempts to expand its authority beyond legality, creating crises that are entirely man-made and avoidable.  What makes the current moment particularly alarming is not just the existence of a constitutional crisis, but the normalization of governance through illegality. Leaders increasingly treat the constitution as an obstacle to navigate, rather than a foundation to uphold. Corruption both financial and political has become embedded within the system, weakening accountability and eroding public confidence in the state. In reflecting on these failures, it is instructive to revisit the leadership philosophy of  A bdirizak Haji Hussein, Somalia’s second prime minister (1964–1967). His approach to governance, particularly during periods of national uncertainty offers a disciplined and principled framework that remains deeply relevant to Somalia’s current disorder. The Constitution as a Moral Covenant For Abdirizak, the constitution was never a flexible political tool to be stretched or reinterpreted for convenience. It was a moral covenant between the state and its people. Today’s constitutional tensions, marked by disputes over power-sharing, contested authority, and selective interpretation of legal provisions would likely concern him deeply. He would argue that the crisis is not simply rooted in legal ambiguity, but in political dishonesty. When leaders deliberately reinterpret or bypass the constitution to serve their own interests, institutions lose credibility and governance becomes unstable. In his view, no short-term political gain can justify weakening the constitutional order. Rather than allowing politicians to act as both players and referees, he would insist on strengthening judicial independence and ensuring that constitutional disputes are resolved by impartial legal institutions, not by those seeking to benefit from them. The Personalization of Power One of the defining characteristics of Abdirizak’s leadership was his rejection of power as a personal entitlement. He understood that public office is temporary and conditional upon trust. In contrast, Somalia’s current political environment is heavily shaped by the personalization of authority. Political competition is no longer about policy or governance, it has become a struggle for control, influence, and survival within the system. Institutions are weakened because they are treated as extensions of individuals rather than independent structures. Abdirizak would likely see this as a dangerous regression. When leaders place themselves above the law, the law itself loses meaning. His voluntary transfer of power in 1967, following the example set by the premiers before him remains a powerful example: leadership is not measured by how long one holds power, but by the integrity with which one exercises, and relinquishes it. Corruption and the Collapse of Legitimacy If there is one issue that would deeply alarm Abdirizak, it is the scale and normalization of corruption in today’s Somalia. During his tenure, accountability was not optional. Today, however, corruption is no longer hidden, it is systemic. Public resources are frequently misused, institutions are compromised, and political decisions are often influenced by personal or factional gain rather than national interest. Abdirizak would interpret this not as a governance flaw, but as a fundamental threat to state legitimacy. Corruption is not merely financial misconduct; it is a betrayal of the Somali people. It destroys trust, weakens institutions, and diverts resources away from essential services. More critically, it undermines the Constitution itself, because a corrupt system cannot enforce laws fairly or consistently. He would likely call for independent anti-corruption institutions with real enforcement power, transparent investigations into the misuse of public funds, strong oversight mechanisms free from political interference, and a cultural shift in which public service is defined by integrity rather than personal gain. Without accountability, even the strongest institutional framework becomes meaningless. Federalism and the Question of Unity Somalia’s federal system was designed to balance power and promote inclusion. However, in practice, it has often become a source of tension and division. Disputes between the federal government and member states over authority, resources, and political control continue to destabilize governance. These conflicts are often intensified by mistrust and political maneuvering rather than resolved through dialogue. Abdirizak would not reject federalism itself. Instead, he would critique how it is being practiced. To him, federalism should be a mechanism for cooperation, not competition. He would likely argue that the current tensions are not structural failures, but leadership failures driven by unwillingness to compromise and prioritize national unity. He would urge all sides to return to dialogue, mutual respect, and shared responsibility recognizing that the strength of Somalia depends on collaboration, not confrontation. Leadership as Ethical Responsibility Perhaps the most striking difference between Abdirizak’s era and today lies in the meaning of leadership. For him, leadership was an ethical duty grounded in humility, discipline, and accountability. Today, however, leadership is too often equated with the accumulation of power, the misuse of public funds, political survival, and the pursuit of control. In moments of constitutional crisis, Abdirizak would likely advocate for restraint. Rather than exploiting legal ambiguities or escalating conflicts, leaders should act to preserve institutional integrity. He would remind them that power is temporary, that institutions must outlast individuals, and that governance must serve the people, not the elite. A Crisis of Political Culture If Abdirizak were to assess Somalia today, he would likely conclude that the constitutional crisis is not merely legal; it is cultural. The real problem lies in the gap between what the constitution represents and how leaders choose to behave. Somalia does not lack laws. It lacks consistent respect for those laws. The repeated manipulation of constitutional provisions, the normalization of corruption, and the erosion of accountability all point to a deeper issue: a governance culture that prioritizes power over principle. Conclusion Abdirizak Haji Hussein would likely view Somalia’s current constitutional crisis as a test of leadership, not just legality. His message would be clear: uphold the constitution without compromise, strengthen institutions instead of individuals, confront corruption as a national emergency, and prioritize unity over political gain. In a political environment defined by instability and short-term thinking, his legacy offers something rare: disciplined, principled leadership rooted in integrity; an imperative and homegrown political philosophy that current and future leaders must learn from. It is a reminder that nations do not fail for lack of systems, but because those entrusted to uphold them choose to undermine them; an unfortunate reality shaping our current leadership dilemma at every level. Lament, My Nation, Lament. Lament not in defeat but in truth for the years stolen by those who mistook power for purpose for a constitution bent until it broke for institutions hollowed until only names remained Lament for what was lost and for what was knowingly destroyed Lament until memory returns until every city echoes a shared refusal to forget Because a nation that forgets its wounds will keep reopening them Then rise Rise with clarity with discipline with a memory that cannot be manipulated To the leaders of today this lament is your judgment You were entrusted with a nation not a throne Power is not permanence it is a test and history will record how you answered To the leaders of tomorrow do not inherit these failures Build institutions that outlive you Protect laws that restrain you Serve people who expect integrity not excuses Lament, my Nation, Lament but do not remain in lament Rise so firmly in integrity that no future generation of yours will ever need to mourn like this again! Anwar Maxamed Diiriye Email: anwaer@usfamily.net The post How Abdirizak Haji Hussein Would Read the Constitutional Crisis and Governance Failures in Somalia Today appeared first on WardheerNews .

Lament not in defeat but in truth for the years stolen by those who mistook power for purpose for a constitution bent until it broke for institutions hollowed until only names remained Lament for what was lost and for what was knowingly destroyed Lament until memory returns until every city echoes a shared refusal to forget Because a nation that forgets its wounds will keep reopening them Then rise Rise with clarity with discipline with a memory that cannot be manipulated To the leaders of today this lament is your judgment You were entrusted with a nation not a throne Power is not permanence it is a test and history will record how you answered To the leaders of tomorrow do not inherit these failures Build institutions that outlive you Protect laws that restrain you Serve people who expect integrity not excuses Lament, my Nation, Lament but do not remain in lament Rise so firmly in integrity that no future generation of yours will ever need to mourn like this again! items.description: Muqdisho ( Raxanreeb Online) Wasiirka wasaradda warfaafinta ee xukuumadda Soomaaliya Cabdifitaax Qaasim ayaa sheegay in uu ka taasulay kursigii xildhibaanimo, isaga oo u hoggaansamay dhaqan gelinta dastuurka cusub uu dhigayo. Wasiir Cabdifitaax ayaa sheegay in la ikhtiraay geliyay inuu kala doorto kurisiga xildhibaannimo ama midka wasiir. Waxa uu tilmaamay in door biday inuu ka taasulo kursiga xildhibannimo. Sidoo kale wasiirka Cabdifitaax, ayaa sheegay in xeerkan uu yahay mid lagu kala saarayo ha’adda fulinta iyo xeer dajinta, isla markaana loo dhaqan geliyo nidaamka dowladnimada ee ku dhisan isla-xisaabtanka. Wasiir Cabdifitaax ayaa maanta si rasmi ah loogu hordhaariyay guddiga joogtada a ee Baarlamaanka Soomaaliya, waxaana dhaariyay Garsoore katirsan maxkamadda sare ee dalka sida uu qabo qodobka 123-aad ee dastuurka. Sikastaba, wasiirka warfaafinta ee xukuumadda Soomaaliya Cabdifitaax Qaasim, ayaa noqonaya mas’uulkii ugu horeeyey ee u hoggaansama isbadalka lagu sameynayo mas’uuliyiin isku haya xilka wasiirnimo iyo xildhibaannimo. items.description: Tehran ( Raxanreeb Online) Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Iiraan ayaa sheegtay in soo jeedinta Tehran ee lagu doonayo in lagu soo afjaro colaadda hadda jirta laguna furo marjinka Hormuz ay ahayd “mid mas’uuliyad leh oo deeqsinimo leh.” Waxay ku eedaysay Washington inay soo jeedisay dalabyo aan macquul ahayn. Mr. Baghaei ayaa ku adkaystay in dalabkooda – oo ay ku jirto in la sii daayo hantida Iiraan ee ku xayiran dibadda – ay yihiin “xuquuq sharci ah” oo Tehran leedahay. items.title: DF oo war kasoo saartay fara-gelin la sheegay inay ka imaaneyso safaaradda Mareykanka
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Soomaaliya ayaa si adag u beenisay warar maalmihii lasoo dhaafay soo baxayay, kuwaas oo sheegayay in Safaaradda Mareykanka ee Muqdisho ay marti-gelin doonto kulan siyaasadeed oo u dhaxeeya dowladda iyo mucaaradka 13-ka bishan May. Wasiiru-dowlaha Arrimaha Dibadda Soomaaliya, Cali Balcad ayaa sheegay in aysan jirin wax fara-gelin siyaasadeed ah oo ay waddo safaaradda Mareykanka, isla markaana aanu jirin kulan noocaas ah oo la qorsheeyay, isagoo xusay in wararkaasi yihiin kuwo aan sal iyo raad lahayn. Cali Balcad ayaa hadalladan ka sheegay dood lagu qabtay barta X Space, halkaas oo uu kaga hadlay xaaladda siyaasadeed ee dalka iyo wararka la xiriira dhex-dhexaadin la sheegay in dhinacyada siyaasadda loogu qabanayo xarunta safaaradda Mareykanka ee Xalane. “Ma jiro kulan la qorsheeyay, mana jirto wax faragelin ah oo safaaradda Mareykanka ka waddo Muqdisho,” ayuu yiri wasiirka, oo tilmaamay in Dowladda Federaalka ay xiriir joogto ah la leedahay saaxiibada caalamka, balse aysan jirin cid si toos ah ugu lug leh khilaafaadka gudaha. Wuxuu sidoo kale sheegay in qaar kamid ah siyaasiyiinta mucaaradka ay dadaal ugu jiraan inay beesha caalamka ku cadaadiyaan dowladda Soomaaliya, isagoo tilmaamay in dowladda ay hayso waraaqo iyo codsiyo arrintaas la xiriira. Sida uu sheegay wasiirku, xubno kamid ah mucaaradka ayaa warqado u diray hay’ado caalami ah oo uu ku jiro Bankiga Adduunka, si loo hakiyo taageerada dhaqaale ee Soomaaliya, taas oo uu ku tilmaamay mid dhaawac ku ah danaha guud ee dalka. “Waxaan moodaa inay ka gudbeen mucaaradnimo oo ay u gudbeen qaab kale oo wax lagu raadinayo,” ayuu yiri Cali Balcad, oo mucaaradka ugu baaqay inay ku tartamaan hannaan siyaasadeed iyo dariiq dimuqraadi ah. Sidoo kale, wasiirka ayaa xusay in Dowladda Federaalka ay diyaar u tahay wada-hadal iyo is-afgarad siyaasadeed, balse ay muhiim tahay in laga fogaado tallaabooyin uu sheegay inay carqaladeyn karaan horumarka iyo taageerada caalamiga ah ee Soomaaliya. Si kastaba, hadalkan ayaa imanaya xilli saacadihii lasoo dhaafay ay soo baxayeen warar sheegaya in Safaaradda Mareykanka ee Muqdisho ay qorsheyneyso kulan ay ku dhex-dhexaadineyso Dowladda Federaalka iyo siyaasiyiinta mucaaradka ah, kuwaas oo isku haya hanaanka doorashooyinka iyo dhaqan-gelinta dastuurka cusub ee la mariyay baarlamaanka. The post DF oo war kasoo saartay fara-gelin la sheegay inay ka imaaneyso safaaradda Mareykanka appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Mucaaradka oo markale ku dhawaaqay banaanbax ka dhan ah dowladda
items.description: Muqdisho ( Raxanreeb Online) Mucaaradka Soomaaliya ayaa markale ku dhawaaqay banaanbax ka dhan dowladda Soomaaliya, kaasi oo ka dhici doona degmooyinka gobolka Banaadir. Qoraalka kasoo baxay golaha mustaqbalka Soomaaliya, ayaa lagu sheegay in madaxweynaha waqtigiisa si dhamaanayo uu hor-istaagay banaanbax nabadeed oo shalay ay soo abaabuleen madasha mucaaradka, kaasi oo ka dhici lahaa magaalada Muqdisho. “Dastuurka kumeel gaarka ah qodobadka 20-aad ayaa dhigaya, in qofkata uu xaq u lee yahay inuu abaabulo kana qeyb galo , kulamo ama banaanbaxyo si xasilooni ah cabasho lagu muujinayo iyada oo ogolaansho loo baahnayn” ayaa lagu yiri qoraalka mucaaradka. Sidoo kale qoraalka mucaaradka ayaa lagu sheegay in banaanbaxa nabadeed uu dhici doono 16-ka may, waxa ayna ka digeen in madasha ay aqbali doonin isku day kasta oo dowladda waqtigeeda sii dhamaanayo ay ku xadideyso banaanbaxa nabdeed. items.title: Somalia Trains First Government Cybersecurity Cohort
items.description: The National Communications Authority (NCA) has completed its first cybersecurity certification training for 15 government officials, closing a month-long program on 10 May 2026 across Mogadishu, online platforms, and Nairobi to protect Somalia’s digital infrastructure. The initiative, launched on 29 March 2026, brought together ICT professionals from 21 government institutions, though only 15 participants representing 15 institutions received completion certificates. The training covered six internationally recognized cybersecurity certifications through a merit-based pathway. This milestone arrives as Somalia accelerates digital transformation in public services and finance, making its critical information infrastructure increasingly vulnerable to cyber threats. With limited homegrown expertise, the program directly addresses a pressing national security gap and aligns with the government’s broader digital ambitions. “The successful completion of the first cohort marks an important step toward building a skilled cybersecurity workforce capable of protecting Somalia’s digital systems and critical information infrastructure,” said NCA Director General Mustafa Yasin Sheikh at the closing ceremony. He commended participants for their dedication and urged them to strengthen cybersecurity practices within their respective institutions.” The World Bank Group funded the program through its SCALED-UP Project, while the African Advanced Level Telecommunications Institute (AFRALTI) facilitated the training. The NCA indicated that this first cohort will be followed by additional groups to address identified training gaps. The authority stated that it will continue expanding cybersecurity capacity-building initiatives and deepen collaboration with international cybersecurity partners to safeguard Somalia’s digital future. The director general emphasized that the workforce must grow in step with the nation’s digital ambitions.

items.title: Israel’s Somaliland Gambit: Red Sea Power Shift
items.description: Jose Lev Alvarez Gomez Israel’s Somaliland Gambit: Red Sea Power Shift People walk by the flags of Israel and Somaliland flying alongside each other at the entrance to a fruit farm between the capital city of Hargeisa and Port city of Berbera along the highway connecting the two as Muslims commemorate the holy month of Ramadan in Somaliland on February 19, 2026. (Tony KARUMBA / AFP). On December 26th, 2025, Israel became the first country to formally recognize Somaliland as an independent state. This was not a symbolic gesture or a fit of diplomatic nostalgia. It was a calculated power move that converted years of quiet, practice-based security cooperation into overt strategic alignment — and in the process, outflanked Turkey, Egypt, and Iran’s Houthi proxies at one of the world’s most critical maritime chokepoints. The numbers expose exactly why the Bab el-Mandeb Strait matters. Before the Houthi campaign, 9.3 million barrels of crude oil and petroleum liquids flowed through it every single day — 12 percent of all seaborne-traded oil on the planet. More than 20,000 vessels pass annually, carrying roughly 10 percent of global maritime commerce. Between November 2023 and October 2024, Iran-backed Houthis launched over 190 documented attacks on commercial shipping and naval vessels. Red Sea traffic plunged by 50 to 70 percent. Suez Canal transits collapsed from 2,068 ships in November 2023 to just 877 by October 2024. Rerouting around the Cape of Good Hope added 10 to 14 days and up to 1 million dollars per voyage in extra fuel, insurance, and operating costs. Global freight rates on Asia-Europe routes spiked 230 percent. This was not random piracy. It was systematic hybrid warfare that turned a commercial artery into a battlefield. Israel’s Modern Doctrine of the Periphery — once built on diplomatic ties with sovereign non-Arab states — has evolved for the age of fragmented sovereignty and proxy conflict. It now embeds peripheral actors like Somaliland into networked maritime security architectures that prioritize geography, operational utility, and persistent access over formal treaties or juridical recognition. Somaliland sits precisely where it counts: at the southern gate of the Bab el-Mandeb, with a stable coastline, functioning governance, and the strategically upgraded Berbera port. That port, expanded through a 442 million dollar investment by DP World, already handles 500,000 twenty-foot equivalent units annually and is on track to reach 2 million. In a securitized maritime theater, those facts matter far more than a seat at the United Nations. Israel’s recognition did not create this relationship; it simply made public what had already been operational. Intelligence coordination, technical assistance, and port access had been routinized for years. The move now raises the relationship to explicit alignment, giving Israel greater optionality along a corridor where Iran projects power through Houthi disruption while Turkey and Egypt have spent years building rival architectures. The backlash was immediate and revealing. Turkey, which has poured resources into Somalia through military training missions and the permanent Turkish base at Camp TURKSOM in Mogadishu, denounced the decision and reaffirmed its commitment to Somali territorial integrity. Egypt, whose entire national security doctrine hinges on unchallenged dominance of the Suez-Red Sea axis, did the same. Joint statements from Arab, Islamic, and African states followed. All of them understood the same reality: a stable, cooperative Somaliland now formally recognized by Israel creates a new node in the Red Sea that bypasses Ankara’s Horn of Africa investments and Cairo’s corridor primacy. This is the new geography of power. In the Red Sea, security governance no longer runs through traditional alliances or United Nations resolutions. It runs through layered coalitions — the Combined Maritime Forces Red Sea task force stood up in 2022, the United States-led Operation Prosperity Guardian, and the European Union defensive maritime operation EUNAVFOR ASPIDES launched in February 2024. These arrangements rely on persistent surveillance, escort missions, and risk management across fragmented spaces. Somaliland’s location and infrastructure make it a natural forward node in that system. Its contribution is measured in maritime domain awareness and logistical reach, not in flag protocols or General Assembly votes. Post-colonial norms that froze African borders in 1964 have been steadily eroded by reality on the ground. In the Red Sea, functional sovereignty — the ability to deliver stability, control territory, and enable security practices — now trumps juridical status. Somaliland has governed itself effectively for decades while much of the Horn of Africa has fractured. Israel simply recognized that operational fact and integrated it into a deterrence network designed to raise the cost of Iranian disruption. High-level follow-through came quickly. In January 2026, Israel’s foreign minister visited Somaliland and signaled plans to deepen political and economic ties, including formal diplomatic representation. Such steps lower barriers to expanded cooperation while preserving the flexibility that opaque arrangements provide in contested environments. Critics will warn of precedent and escalation. Those concerns miss the structural point. When asymmetric actors can threaten 12 percent of global oil flows and force trillion-dollar adjustments in supply chains, strategic geography and reliable partners outweigh outdated diplomatic taboos. Israel has demonstrated that middle powers can still reshape regional orders by converting practice-based relationships into explicit footholds at critical nodes. The Red Sea is no longer a neutral transit corridor. It is a contested theater where control of flows — energy, shipping, data, and risk — determines influence. By recognizing Somaliland, Israel has expanded its strategic depth, complicated its adversaries’ calculations, and reinforced a networked deterrence architecture that matters more than any single treaty. In the hybrid-war age, this is how serious players operate. The periphery is no longer peripheral. It is the new frontline. About the Author Jose Lev is an American-Israeli scholar focused on Israel Studies and Middle Eastern security policy. A multilingual veteran of both the Israel Defense Forces’ special forces and the U.S. Army, he holds a B.S. in Neuroscience with a Minor in Israel Studies from American University in Washington, D.C., three master’s degrees, and a medical degree as well. Currently, he is completing a Ph.D. in Intelligence and Global Security in the Washington, D.C. area. Alongside blogging for The Times of Israel, he is a writing fellow at the U.S.-based think tank Middle East Forum; regularly appears on Latin American television networks to provide geopolitical and security analysis; and is a member of the Association for Israel Studies.

More than 20,000 vessels pass annually, carrying roughly 10 percent of global maritime commerce. Between November 2023 and October 2024, Iran-backed Houthis launched over 190 documented attacks on commercial shipping and naval vessels. Red Sea traffic plunged by 50 to 70 percent. Suez Canal transits collapsed from 2,068 ships in November 2023 to just 877 by October 2024. Rerouting around the Cape of Good Hope added 10 to 14 days and up to 1 million dollars per voyage in extra fuel, insurance, and operating costs. Global freight rates on Asia-Europe routes spiked 230 percent. This was not random piracy. It was systematic hybrid warfare that turned a commercial artery into a battlefield. Israel’s Modern Doctrine of the Periphery — once built on diplomatic ties with sovereign non-Arab states — has evolved for the age of fragmented sovereignty and proxy conflict. It now embeds peripheral actors like Somaliland into networked maritime security architectures that prioritize geography, operational utility, and persistent access over formal treaties or juridical recognition. Somaliland sits precisely where it counts: at the southern gate of the Bab el-Mandeb, with a stable coastline, functioning governance, and the strategically upgraded Berbera port. That port, expanded through a 442 million dollar investment by DP World, already handles 500,000 twenty-foot equivalent units annually and is on track to reach 2 million. In a securitized maritime theater, those facts matter far more than a seat at the United Nations. Israel’s recognition did not create this relationship; it simply made public what had already been operational. Intelligence coordination, technical assistance, and port access had been routinized for years. The move now raises the relationship to explicit alignment, giving Israel greater optionality along a corridor where Iran projects power through Houthi disruption while Turkey and Egypt have spent years building rival architectures. The backlash was immediate and revealing. Turkey, which has poured resources into Somalia through military training missions and the permanent Turkish base at Camp TURKSOM in Mogadishu, denounced the decision and reaffirmed its commitment to Somali territorial integrity. Egypt, whose entire national security doctrine hinges on unchallenged dominance of the Suez-Red Sea axis, did the same. Joint statements from Arab, Islamic, and African states followed. All of them understood the same reality: a stable, cooperative Somaliland now formally recognized by Israel creates a new node in the Red Sea that bypasses Ankara’s Horn of Africa investments and Cairo’s corridor primacy. This is the new geography of power. In the Red Sea, security governance no longer runs through traditional alliances or United Nations resolutions. It runs through layered coalitions — the Combined Maritime Forces Red Sea task force stood up in 2022, the United States-led Operation Prosperity Guardian, and the European Union defensive maritime operation EUNAVFOR ASPIDES launched in February 2024. These arrangements rely on persistent surveillance, escort missions, and risk management across fragmented spaces. Somaliland’s location and infrastructure make it a natural forward node in that system. Its contribution is measured in maritime domain awareness and logistical reach, not in flag protocols or General Assembly votes. Post-colonial norms that froze African borders in 1964 have been steadily eroded by reality on the ground. In the Red Sea, functional sovereignty — the ability to deliver stability, control territory, and enable security practices — now trumps juridical status. Somaliland has governed itself effectively for decades while much of the Horn of Africa has fractured. Israel simply recognized that operational fact and integrated it into a deterrence network designed to raise the cost of Iranian disruption. High-level follow-through came quickly. In January 2026, Israel’s foreign minister visited Somaliland and signaled plans to deepen political and economic ties, including formal diplomatic representation. Such steps lower barriers to expanded cooperation while preserving the flexibility that opaque arrangements provide in contested environments. Critics will warn of precedent and escalation. Those concerns miss the structural point. When asymmetric actors can threaten 12 percent of global oil flows and force trillion-dollar adjustments in supply chains, strategic geography and reliable partners outweigh outdated diplomatic taboos. Israel has demonstrated that middle powers can still reshape regional orders by converting practice-based relationships into explicit footholds at critical nodes. The Red Sea is no longer a neutral transit corridor. It is a contested theater where control of flows — energy, shipping, data, and risk — determines influence. By recognizing Somaliland, Israel has expanded its strategic depth, complicated its adversaries’ calculations, and reinforced a networked deterrence architecture that matters more than any single treaty. In the hybrid-war age, this is how serious players operate. The periphery is no longer peripheral. It is the new frontline. About the Author Jose Lev is an American-Israeli scholar focused on Israel Studies and Middle Eastern security policy. A multilingual veteran of both the Israel Defense Forces’ special forces and the U.S. Army, he holds a B.S. in Neuroscience with a Minor in Israel Studies from American University in Washington, D.C., three master’s degrees, and a medical degree as well. Currently, he is completing a Ph.D. in Intelligence and Global Security in the Washington, D.C. area. Alongside blogging for The Times of Israel, he is a writing fellow at the U.S.-based think tank Middle East Forum; regularly appears on Latin American television networks to provide geopolitical and security analysis; and is a member of the Association for Israel Studies.

items.title: Golaha Shacabka oo dhaariyey Wasiirka Warfaafinta cusub
items.description: Golaha Shacabka oo dhaariyey Wasiirka Warfaafinta cusub Muqdisho, 11 May 2026 – Guddiga joogtada ah ee Golaha Shacabka Baarlamaanka Soomaaliya ayaa maanta xarunta Villa Hargeysa ku qabtay kulankooda ajandahiisu ahaa dhaarinta Wasiirka cusub ee Wasaaradda Warfaafinta, Dhaqanka iyo Dalxiiska, Mudane Cabdifitaax Qaasim Maxamuud, iyadoo shirka guddoomiyey Guddoomiye-ku-xigeenka koowaad, Sacdiya Yaasiin Xaaji Samatar. Dhaarintu waxay ka dhigan tahay in wasiirka cusub uu si rasmi ah ula wareegayo xilka ka dib markii uu baarlamaanka ku ansixiyay golaha wasiirrada. Soomaaliya waxay haddaba heshay wasiir cusub oo mas’uul ka ah qaabeynta siyaasadda warfaafinta, dhaqanka, iyo dalxiiska – door muhiim u ah qaabeynta aragtida dalka iyo dhiirrigelinta horumarinta dhaqanka. “Waxaan hambalyo u dirayaa Wasiirka cusub, waxaanan ka rajeynayaa inuu si daacad ah ugu adeego ummadda, qaranka, iyo shacabka Soomaaliyeed,” ayuu yiri Guddoomiye-ku-xigeenka Sacdiya Yaasiin Xaaji Samatar intii ay kulanku socotay. Waxa ay ku boorrisay inuu ka shaqeeyo tayaynta warbaahinta qaranka iyo kor u qaadista heerarka warfaafinta. Dhaarinta waxaa fuliyay Garsoore Cabdiqafaar Xuseen Isaaq oo ka tirsan Maxkamadda Sare ee dalka, isagoo wakiil ka ahaa Guddoomiyaha Maxkamadda Sare. Wasiirka ayaa dhaarta ka dib waxa uu u cadaadiyey baarlamaanka inuu xilka uu qabanayo si hufan u guto, isagoo ballan qaaday inuu sii xoojin doono xoriyadda iyo mas’uuliyadda warbaahinta. Maalintii dhaayey, waxaa guddiga joogtada ah ka qeyb galay xubno badan oo ka tirsan Golaha Shacabka, waxaana kulanka looga hadlay baahida loo qabo in la abuuro istaraatiijiyad warfaafin oo waafaqsan qorshaha qaranka. Wasiirka ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in dalxiiska Soomaaliya uu yahay mid leh fursado badan, isagoo qorsheeynaya inuu soo jiito maalgashiga goobaha taariikhiga ah. Warfaafinta, dhaqanka, iyo dalxiiska ayaa ah saddex qaybood oo xiriir dhow leh, waxaana laga filayaa Wasiirka cusub inuu bixiyo qorshe cad oo lagu horumarinayo heerarka waddanka.

items.title: Farmaajo oo si kulul uga hadlay xarigga Cabdi Cali iyo Maxamed Cabdi
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynihii hore ee Soomaaliya, Mudane Maxamed Cabdullahi Maxamed (Farmaajo) ayaa si kulul uga hadlay xarigga loo gaystay Maxamed Cabdi Yuusuf iyo Cabdi Cali Ibraahim oo kamid ah dhalinyarada Bajaajleyda ee ka howlgala gudaha magaalada Muqdisho. Warsaxaafadeed uu soo saaray Farmaajo ayaa waxa uu ku cambaareeyay xarigga labadaan wiil, isaga oo ku tilmaamay sharci darro. “Waxaan si adag u cambaaraynaynaa afduubka iyo xarigga sharci darrada ah ee loo gaystay muwaadiniinta xoogsatada Bajaajlayda ah ee lagu xiray magaalada Muqdisho, gaar ahaan Maxamed Cabdi Yuusuf iyo Cabdi Cali Ibraahim,” ayuu qoraalkiisa ku yiri Maxamed Farmaajo. Sidoo kale wuxuu kusii daray “Caburinta codka shacabka, handadaadda dadka danyarta ah iyo xarigga muwaadiniinta cabashadooda dhiibanaya ma ahan xal lagu dhisi karo caddaalad, dowladnimo iyo kalsoonida bulshada”. Dhanka kale, waxa uu farriin u diray hay’adaha amniga isaga oo ugu baaqay inay si deg-deg ah usii daayaan dhalinyarada xiran, siidoo kalena la joojiyay caburin uu sheegay in lagu codka shacabka, sida uu hadalka u dhigay. “Waxaan ugu baaqaynaa hay’adaha amniga in si deg-deg ah xorriyaddooda loogu soo celiyo muwaadiniintaas, islamarkaana la joojiyo tallaabooyinka lagu caburinayo shacabka rayidka ah ee aragtidooda cabbiraya, si waafaqsan dastuurka dalka,” ayuu mar kale yiri Madaxweyniii hore ee dalka. Maalmihii u dambeeyay Farmaajo ayaa soo saarayay qoraallo ka dhan ah tallaabooyinka dowladda, waxaana u dambeysay shalay oo uu cambaareeyay rasaas ay ciidanka amniga ku fureen dad ku banaanbaxayay degmada Dayniile, taas oo dhalisay khasaare isugu jiro dhimasho iyo dhaawac intaba. Si kastaba, mucaaradka ayaa diidan hannaanka uu wax ku wado Xasan Sheekh waxayna wadaan dhaq-dhaqaaqyo siyaasadeed oo si weyn looga dareemay magaalada Muqdisho. The post Farmaajo oo si kulul uga hadlay xarigga Cabdi Cali iyo Maxamed Cabdi appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Wasiiru Dowlaha Arrimaha Dibadda oo Dhaleeceeyay Xeeladaha Mucaaradka, Kuna Baaqay in la Muujiyo Bisayl Siyaasadeed.
items.description: Wasiiru-dowlaha Arrimaha Dibadda Soomaaliya, Mudane Cali Balcad ayaa sheegay in qaar kamid ah mucaaradka Soomaaliya ay isu beddeleen hoggaamiye-kooxeedyadii hore, isagoo ku eedeeyay inay warqado u diraan hay’adaha caalamiga ah sida World Bank si cadaadis loogu saaro dowladda Soomaaliya ama loo hakiyo taageerada la siiyo dalka. Wasiirka ayaa sheegay in tallaabooyinka noocaas ah ay dhaawac ku yihiin dowlad-dhiska, horumarka dalka iyo dadaallada lagu xasilinayo Soomaaliya. Waxa uu xusay in dowladda Federaalka ay ku howlan tahay dib-u-dhis iyo horumar, isla markaana loo baahan yahay in laga wada shaqeeyo midnimada iyo danaha qaranka. Sidoo kale, Cali Balcad ayaa ugu baaqay siyaasiyiinta mucaaradka in khilaafaadka jira lagu xalliyo wadahadal iyo hannaan siyaasadeed oo dastuuri ah, halkii la adeegsan lahaa cadaadis dibadeed oo saameyn kara taageerada ay Soomaaliya ka hesho beesha caalamka.

items.title: Sarkaalka loo magacaabay Taliyaha Booliska Galmudug oo si leexsan xilka ula wareegay
items.description: Korneyl Maxamed Daahir Cabdulle oo toddobaadkii hore uu Taliska Ciidanka Booliska Soomaaliyeed u magacaabay inuu noqdo Taliyaha Booliska Galmudug ayaa maanta xilka la wareegay, ka dib munaasabad ka dhacday Magaalada Dhuusamareeb. Munaasabadda ayaa waxaa goobjoog ka ahaa Taliye Kuxigeenka Ciidanka Booliska Soomaaliyeed, General Cismaan Cabdullaahi Maxamed (Kaniif) iyo inta badan Saraakiisha Booliska iyo Nabad Sugidda Galmudug. Magacaabidda Taliyaha cusub ayaa waxaa Khamiistii ka horyimid Madaxweynaha Dowlad Goboleedka Galmudug, Axmed Cabdi Kaariye (Qoorqoor) oo dib u soo magacaabay Korneyl Khaliif Cabdulle Maalin, kaas oo sanadihii u dambeeyay ku magacawnaa Taliyaha Booliska Galmudug. Ilo wareedyo muhiim ah ayaa sheegaya in Madaxweyne Qoorqoor uu weli ka biyo diidan tahay magacaabidda Taliyaha cusub, iyadoo munaasabadda uu xilka kula wareegay uu ka maqnaa Taliyaha loo wado in uu bedelo. General Kaniif, Taliye Kuxigeenka Ciidanka Booliska Soomaaliyeed ayaa Saraakiisha Booliska Galmudug faray in ay la shaqeeyaan Taliyaha cusub ee Ciidanka Booliska Galmudug. “Wax kasta iyo rabitaankana waxaa ka weyn dadka shacabka ah shaqada loo qabanayo.” Ayuu yiri General Kaniif oo ka hadlayay munaasabadda. Dowladda Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa ku foogan, sidii ay ula wareegi lahayd amniga Magaalada Dhuusamareeb, sababtuna waa inay tahay meesha ay ku shaqayn doonaan Xubnaha Guddiga Doorashooyinka Qaranka, si ay u maamulaan doorashada billaha June iyo July laga qabanayo deegaanada Galmudug. Doorashada Golaha Deegaanka ee Degmooyinka ayuu qorshuhu yahay in la qabto 20-ka bisha June, iyadoo midda Xildhibaanada Baarlamaankana la qaban doono 2-da July, halka Doorashada Hoggaanka Galmudug la muddeeyay in la qabto 9-ka July. Dowladda Federaalka ayaa waxaa la leeyahay xisaabta uguma jirto in wada hadal lagu dhameeyo khilaafka u dhaxeeya Madaxda Qaranka iyo Qoorqoor, maadaama Qoorqoor uu doonayo in uu dib ugu soo laabto xafiiska, dowladduna ay booskiisu u waddo shakhsi kale, tiiyoo ay jirto ayaa la sheegaya in dowladdu ay haddana welwel ka muujineyso in Qoorqoor uu carqaladeeyo doorashada soo socota.

items.title: HIQ oo xiray tababarkii shahaadooyinka amniga saaybarka
items.description: HIQ oo xiray tababarkii shahaadooyinka amniga saaybarka Nayroobi, Kenya – 11 Maajo 2026 – Hay’adda Isgaarsiinta Qaranka (HIQ) ayaa maanta si rasmi ah u soo gebagebeysay wejiga koowaad ee barnaamijka tababarka shahaadooyinka amniga saaybarka ee shaqaalaha dowladda, kaas oo socday intii u dhaxeysay 29 Maarso ilaa 10 Maajo 2026, iyadoo ay ka qeyb galeen saraakiil ICT ah oo ka tirsan 21 hay’adood oo dowladda ah. Barnaamijkan ayaa muhiimad weyn u leh dadaallada Soomaaliya ee lagu xoojinayo kaabayaasha dhijitaalka ah, iyadoo hanjabaadaha saaybarku ay noqdeen kuwa sii kordhaya adduunka oo dhan. Helista shahaadooyin caalami ah waxay u suurtagelinaysaa shaqaalaha dowladda inay ilaaliyaan macluumaadka qaranka iyo kaabayaasha muhiimka ah. “Soo gabagabeynta wejigan koowaad waxay tallaabo muhiim ah u tahay dadaallada lagu dhisayo shaqaale xirfad sare leh oo awood u leh ilaalinta nidaamyada dhijitaalka ah ee dalkeenna,” ayuu yiri Maareeyaha Guud ee HIQ, Mudane Mustafa Yaasiin Sheekh. “Hay’addu waxaa ka go’an inay sii xoojiso dadaalladan iyada oo hirgelin doonta wejiyo kale oo dheeraad ah, si loo hubiyo in awoodda shaqaalaha ay la jaanqaaddo himilooyinka dhijitaalka ah ee dalka.” Maareeyaha Guud ayaa bogaadiyay ka qeybgalayaasha dadaalka ay muujiyeen, wuxuuna ku dhiirrigeliyay inay aqoonta ay barteen u adeegsadaan xoojinta amniga saaybarka ee hay’adahooda. Tababarka ayaa lagu bixiyay qaab isku dhafan – Muqdisho, fogaan-arag (online), iyo Nayroobi. Waxaa ka qeyb galay 15 mas’uul oo ka socday 15 hay’adood, kuwaas oo dhammeystay lix shahaado oo caalami ah oo ku saabsan amniga saaybarka. Munaasabadda gunaanadka ayaa shahaadooyin lagu guddoonsiiyay dhammaan ka qeybgalayaasha. Barnaamijka waxaa maalgeliyey Bangiga Adduunka (World Bank Group) iyada oo loo marayo mashruuca SCALED-UP, waxaana fududeeyay Machadka Sare ee Isgaarsiinta ee Afrika (AFRALTI). items.title: US to mediate Somalia election crisis talks as president Hassan Sheikh Mohamud’s term nears end
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – With Somalia edging towards another political cliff-edge, the United States is set to mediate high-stakes talks between the Somali federal government and opposition leaders in Mogadishu on 13 May, in what diplomats hope could avert a fresh constitutional and security crisis before Somali President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud’s mandate expires two days later, Caasimada Online news website reported on Monday. The meeting, to be held inside the heavily fortified Halane compound at Mogadishu’s Aden Adde International Airport, marks the first formal American mediation effort in Somalia’s intensifying political dispute. The base hosts multiple foreign diplomatic missions, including the US embassy, and is regarded as the most secure zone in the Somali capital. Somali President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud and Somali Prime Minister Hamza Abdi Barre are expected to represent the Somali federal government, while the opposition Somali Future Council delegation will include Puntland leader Saeed Abdullahi Deni and former Somali president Sharif Sheikh Ahmed. The breakthrough follows weeks of mounting tension and behind-the-scenes diplomacy, after Somali opposition figures formally requested Washington’s involvement last month amid fears that the Somalia electoral deadlock could spiral into violence. International partners meeting in Mogadishu last week reportedly urged both camps to commit to dialogue, warning that continued political confrontation risked destabilising Somalia at a time when the Horn of Africa nation is still battling a resilient Islamist insurgency and fragile state institutions. The talks come against an increasingly volatile backdrop in the Somali capital. Over the past two days, heavily armed Somali government forces, backed by armoured vehicles and tanks, have been deployed across key junctions in Mogadishu after authorities moved to prevent an opposition-organised rally protesting land seizures and forced evictions. Western diplomats and regional observers have since intensified efforts to calm tensions, fearing a repeat of the deadly divisions witnessed in April 2021, when rival factions within the Somali security forces exchanged gunfire in Mogadishu after disputes over delayed Somalia elections and term extensions plunged the country into crisis. For many Somalis, Washington’s decision to step in reflects growing international alarm over the deepening Somalia political impasse and recognition that external pressure may now be one of the few remaining tools capable of compelling compromise. Diplomats say the United States and its allies possess considerable leverage, including the threat of sanctions, visa bans and travel restrictions against individuals accused of obstructing dialogue or undermining democratic processes in Somalia. Some analysts believe such measures could push both sides towards a negotiated settlement and prevent Somalia’s political tensions from descending into armed confrontation. “The concern among international partners is that Somalia cannot afford another prolonged political standoff,” one regional analyst in Mogadishu said. “There is fear that renewed instability would reverse years of Somali state-building efforts and distract from the fight against Al-Shabaab.” The Somalia political dispute centres on the future of the country’s electoral model. President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud has repeatedly defended plans to transition Somalia towards a one-person, one-vote electoral system – a long-promised democratic reform that supporters argue would strengthen Somali political legitimacy and move the country away from its clan-based indirect voting structure. The Somali president has portrayed the reforms as a historic opportunity to modernise Somalia’s political system after decades of conflict and instability. But Somali opposition leaders accuse the government of using the proposed reforms as a pretext to extend its grip on power beyond the constitutional term limit. They argue that organising universal suffrage elections in Somalia under the current political and security climate would be logistically impossible within the remaining timeframe and could create a constitutional vacuum once the president’s mandate expires on 15 May. Instead, the Somali opposition is calling for a return to Somalia’s traditional indirect electoral model, under which clan elders and delegates select lawmakers who then elect the president. They say such a process could be organised more quickly and would ensure a smoother transfer of power while avoiding institutional collapse. Repeated negotiations between the two sides have failed in recent months, with opposition figures accusing the Somali president of inflexibility and refusing to compromise on key electoral arrangements. The deadlock has deepened uncertainty across Somalia and sharpened divisions between the Somali federal authorities and some regional administrations, particularly Puntland, which has openly challenged Mogadishu’s political direction. The stakes are especially high for Somalia, a country emerging from decades of civil conflict and still dependent on substantial international support for security and development. Since the collapse of Somalia’s central government in 1991, international donors – led by the United States, the European Union and the United Nations – have invested billions of dollars into rebuilding Somali state institutions, training Somali security forces and supporting democratic processes in Somalia. Many Somalis fear that renewed political conflict could erode public trust in Somalia’s fragile government and derail hard-won gains achieved over the past decade. Despite the tensions, analysts monitoring Somalia’s renewed mediation effort say there remains cautious optimism that direct engagement between the rival camps could produce at least a temporary agreement to prevent escalation. Whether the Halane talks can bridge Somalia’s widening political divide, however, remains uncertain. For now, Somalia waits anxiously as its leaders face mounting pressure to pull back from confrontation and steer the Horn of Africa nation away from another dangerous chapter in its turbulent history. items.title: DF Soomaaliya oo amar siisay ciidamada jooga Galmudug
items.description: Dhuusamareeb (Caasimada Online) – Taliye Ku-xigeenka Ciidanka Booliiska Soomaaliya Sarreeye Guuto Cismaan Cabdullahi Maxamed (Kaniif) oo ka qayb-galay munaasabad uu xilka kula wareegay taliyaha cusub ee qaybta Booliska Galmudug Gaashaanle Sare Maxamed Daahir Cabdulle ayaa amar siiyay saraakiisha iyo ciidamada Booliska ee ka howlgala deegaannada maamulkaas, xilli ay taagan tahay xiisad u dhexeyso dowladda iyo Galmudug. Munaasabadda waxaa ka baaqday taliyihii xilka laga qaaday Gaashaanle Sare Khaliif Cabdulle Maalin, kaas oo la saftay Madaxweyne Qoor-Qoor oo mar kale dib usoo magacaabay, waxayna taas keentay in xilka uu wareejiyo mid kamid ah saraakiishii Booliska ee gacanta ku hayay faylasha shaqada. Kaniif oo ka hadlay xil-wareejinta ayaa faray dhammaan ciidamada inay si buuxda ula shaqeeyaan taliye Maxamed Daahir, ayna u hoggaansamaan amaradiisa oo toos uga imaanayo dhanka Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya. “Xil wareejinta maanta halkan ka dhacday oo lagu soo dhaweynaayo taliyaha qaybta waxay qayb ka tahay xafladihii hore oo saas oo kale dhici jiray, waxaan rabaa Booliska inaan u sheego dhammaantiin isbeddelka cusub ee lasoo sameeyay oo taliyaha qaybta ah in lala shaqeeyo si shaqada bulshada loo haayaa ay usoo baxdo,” ayuu yiri Taliye ku xigeenka Booliiska Soomaaliya. Sidoo kale, wuxuu ku adkeeyay inay xoojiyaan shaqadooda, isla markaana ay ka shaqeeyaan sarreynta sharciga iyo u adeegidda shacabka Soomaaliyeed. “Waa inaa shaqadiina kor u qaadaan waa inaa sharciga ka shaqeysaan waa inaa kala dambeynta ka shaqeysaan, una kala garsoortaan dadka shacabka ah,” ayuu mar kale yiri Sarreeye Guuto Cismaan Cabdullahi Maxamed (Kaniif). Arrintan ayaa kusoo aadeyso, iyada oo dhawaan ay kala fogaadeen Qoor Qoor iyo Xasan Sheekh, kadib markii uu ka dhex-qarxay khilaaf xooggan. Si kastaba, arrimaha haatan kasoo cusboonaaday Galmudug ayaa salka ku haya doorashada maamulkaas, wuxuuna khilaafkan bilow u yahay mowjado siyaasadeed oo maalmaha socda ku wajahan magaalada Dhuusamareeb. items.title: Xasan Sheekh oo u baxay safar dibadeed + Ujeedka
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya, Mudane Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud iyo wafdi uu hoggaaminayo ayaa maanta u ambabaxay magaaada Kampala ee caasimada dalka Uganda, kadib casuumaad rasmi ah oo uu ka helay dhiggiisa dalkaasi, Yoweri Museven. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa ka qayb-galaya caleema saarka Madaxweyne Yoweri Museveni oo mar kale kusoo baxay doorashada Uganda, taas oo dhaceysa berri oo Talaado ah ah, kuna beegan 12-ka May 2026. Xasan Sheekh ayaa ka mid ah madaxda dalalka gobolka, hoggaamiyeyaal caalami ah iyo wufuud heer sare ah oo lagu casuumay munaasabadda, isaga oo halkaas ka jeedin doono khudbad nuxurkeedu yahay hambalyo iyo bogaadin uu u dirayo madaxweynaha dib loo doortay ee Yoweri Museven. Sidoo kale, madaxweynaha ayaa qorshuhu yahay inuu la kulmo madaxda sare ee dowladda Uganda iyo hoggaamiyeyaasha kale ee isugu tegaya Kampala, isaga oo kala hadli doono arrimo ku aadan xoojinta taageerada Soomaaliya, Waa munaasabaddii labaad ee uu ka qayb-galayo Madaxweynuhu wuxuu maalin kahor tegay munaasabadda caleemo-saarka Madaxweynaha dib loo doortay ee Jamhuuriyadda Jabuuti Mudane Ismaaciil Cumar Geelle, taasi oo ka dhacday magaalada Jabuuti ee caasimadda dalka Jamhuuriyadda Jabuuti. Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya oo u hambaleeyay Madaxweyne Geelle iyo shacabka dalka Jabuuti ayaa xusay muhiimadda ay leedahay xoojinta iskaashiga walaaltinimo ee u dhexeeya labada dal ee Soomaaliya iyo Jabuuti. Jabuuti iyo Uganda ayaa kamid ah dalalka taageero Soomaaliya, kana caawiya dhanka ammaanka, maadaama ay ciidamo ka joogaan gudaha dalka, kuwaas oo ka qayb-qaata howlgallada ka dhanka ah argagixisada ee Al-Shabaab. The post Xasan Sheekh oo u baxay safar dibadeed + Ujeedka appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Hay’adda Isgaarsiinta Qaranka oo Soo Gebagebeysay Wejiga Koowaad ee Tababarka Shahaadooyinka Amniga Saaybarka ee Shaqaalaha Dowladda
items.description: Nayroobi, Kenya – 11 Maajo 2026 — Hay’adda Isgaarsiinta Qaranka (HIQ) ayaa si rasmi ah u soo gebagebeysay wejiga koowaad ee Barnaamijka Tababarka ee ku saabsanaa Shahaadooyinka Amniga Saaybarka ee shaqaalaha dowladda, taasoo astaan muhiim ah u ah dadaallada lagu xoojinayo xirfadaha iyo aqoonta shaqaalaha dowladda ee amniga saaybarka iyo ilaalinta kaabayaasha dhijitaalka ah ee qaranka. Barnaamijka, oo socday intii u dhexeysay 29 Maarso ilaa 10 Maajo 2026, ayaa waxaa ka qeyb galay saraakiil ka tirsan waaxyaha ICT-da ee 21 hay’adood oo dowladda ka tirsan, kuwaas oo lagu tababaray aqoon iyo xirfado u suurtagelinaya inay helaan shahaadooyin caalami ah oo ku saabsan amniga saaybarka. Tababarka ayaa lagu bixiyay hannaan nidaamsan oo ku dhisan mudnaan iyo karti, waxaana lagu qabtay Muqdisho, qaab fogaan-arag (online), iyo magaalada Nayroobi ee dalka Kenya. Maareeyaha Guud ee Hay’adda Isgaarsiinta Qaranka, Mudane Mustafa Yaasiin Sheekh, oo ka hadlay munaasabadda gunaanadka barnaamijka tababarka, ayaa yiri: “Soo gabagabeynta wejigan koowaad waxay tallaabo muhiim ah u tahay dadaallada lagu dhisayo shaqaale xirfad sare leh oo awood u leh ilaalinta nidaamyada dhijitaalka ah ee dalkeenna iyo Kaabeyaasha Muhiimka ah ee Macluumaadka Qaranka. Hay’addu waxaa ka go’an inay sii xoojiso dadaalladan iyada oo hirgelin doonta wejiyo kale oo dheeraad ah, si loo hubiyo in awoodda shaqaalaha ee amniga saaybarka ay la jaanqaaddo himilooyinka dhijitaalka ah ee dalka.” Maareeyaha Guud ayaa sidoo kale bogaadiyay dadaalka iyo sida ay uga go’neyd ka-qaybgalayaasha dhammeystirka barnaamijka, isagoo ku dhiirrigeliyay inay aqoonta iyo xirfadaha ay barteen u adeegsadaan xoojinta hababka amniga saaybarka ee hay’adahooda. Barnaamijka ayaa ka koobnaa lix shahaadooyin caalami ah oo ku saabsan Amniga Saaybarka. Ka dib markii ay si guul leh u dhammeysteen tababarka, ka-qaybgalayaasha oo ka kooban 15 Mas’uul oo ka kala socday 15 Hay’adood, waxaa la guddoonsiiyay shahaadooyin lagu aqoonsanayo dhammeystirka tababarka iyo heerka aqooneed ee ay gaareen intii uu socday Tababarka. Barnaamijkan tababarka waxaa maalgeliyey oo taageeray Bangiga Adduunka (World Bank Group) iyada oo loo marayo mashruuca SCALED-UP, waxaana fududeeyay Machadka Sare ee Isgaarsiinta ee Afrika (AFRALTI). Hay’adda Isgaarsiinta Qaranka waxay sii wadi doontaa ballaarinta barnaamijyada lagu horumarinayo aqoonta iyo xirfada amniga saaybarka, wax ka qabashada baahiyaha jira, iyo xoojinta iskaashiga lala leeyahay saaxiibadda iyo hay’addaha caalamiga ee ka shaqeeya amniga saaybarka ah, si loo sii horumariyo mustaqbalka dhijitaalka ah ee dalka.

Barnaamijka, oo socday intii u dhexeysay 29 Maarso ilaa 10 Maajo 2026, ayaa waxaa ka qeyb galay saraakiil ka tirsan waaxyaha ICT-da ee 21 hay’adood oo dowladda ka tirsan, kuwaas oo lagu tababaray aqoon iyo xirfado u suurtagelinaya inay helaan shahaadooyin caalami ah oo ku saabsan amniga saaybarka. Tababarka ayaa lagu bixiyay hannaan nidaamsan oo ku dhisan mudnaan iyo karti, waxaana lagu qabtay Muqdisho, qaab fogaan-arag (online), iyo magaalada Nayroobi ee dalka Kenya. Maareeyaha Guud ee Hay’adda Isgaarsiinta Qaranka, Mudane Mustafa Yaasiin Sheekh, oo ka hadlay munaasabadda gunaanadka barnaamijka tababarka, ayaa yiri: “Soo gabagabeynta wejigan koowaad waxay tallaabo muhiim ah u tahay dadaallada lagu dhisayo shaqaale xirfad sare leh oo awood u leh ilaalinta nidaamyada dhijitaalka ah ee dalkeenna iyo Kaabeyaasha Muhiimka ah ee Macluumaadka Qaranka. Hay’addu waxaa ka go’an inay sii xoojiso dadaalladan iyada oo hirgelin doonta wejiyo kale oo dheeraad ah, si loo hubiyo in awoodda shaqaalaha ee amniga saaybarka ay la jaanqaaddo himilooyinka dhijitaalka ah ee dalka.” Maareeyaha Guud ayaa sidoo kale bogaadiyay dadaalka iyo sida ay uga go’neyd ka-qaybgalayaasha dhammeystirka barnaamijka, isagoo ku dhiirrigeliyay inay aqoonta iyo xirfadaha ay barteen u adeegsadaan xoojinta hababka amniga saaybarka ee hay’adahooda. Barnaamijka ayaa ka koobnaa lix shahaadooyin caalami ah oo ku saabsan Amniga Saaybarka. Ka dib markii ay si guul leh u dhammeysteen tababarka, ka-qaybgalayaasha oo ka kooban 15 Mas’uul oo ka kala socday 15 Hay’adood, waxaa la guddoonsiiyay shahaadooyin lagu aqoonsanayo dhammeystirka tababarka iyo heerka aqooneed ee ay gaareen intii uu socday Tababarka. Barnaamijkan tababarka waxaa maalgeliyey oo taageeray Bangiga Adduunka (World Bank Group) iyada oo loo marayo mashruuca SCALED-UP, waxaana fududeeyay Machadka Sare ee Isgaarsiinta ee Afrika (AFRALTI). Hay’adda Isgaarsiinta Qaranka waxay sii wadi doontaa ballaarinta barnaamijyada lagu horumarinayo aqoonta iyo xirfada amniga saaybarka, wax ka qabashada baahiyaha jira, iyo xoojinta iskaashiga lala leeyahay saaxiibadda iyo hay’addaha caalamiga ee ka shaqeeya amniga saaybarka ah, si loo sii horumariyo mustaqbalka dhijitaalka ah ee dalka.

items.title: Faransiiska oo sheegay in xariirka uu afrika la leedahay uu galayo marxalad cusub oo iskaashi ah
items.description: Madaxweynaha Emmanuel Macron ayaa hadal si weyn loo hadal hayo ka jeediyay shir madaxeed ka socda Kenya, kaas oo ay ka qeyb galayaan in ka badan 30 hoggaamiye Afrikaan ah. Macron ayaa sheegay in xiriirka u dhexeeya Fransiiska iyo qaaradda Afrika uu galayo marxalad cusub oo ku dhisan iskaashi dhaqaale, maalgashi iyo horumar wadajir ah. Macron ayaa Afrika ku tilmaamay qaaradda ugu da’da yar dunida, isagoo xusay in koboca dhaqaale ee qaaraddu uu sannadaha soo socda ka dheereyn karo dalalka Koonfur-bari Aasiya. Shirkan oo ka socda magaalada Nairobi ayaa diiradda lagu saarayaa maalgashiga, tamarta nadiifta ah, teknoolojiyadda, iyo sidii Afrika ay u heli lahayd fursado dhaqaale oo ka cadaalad badan nidaamka maaliyadeed ee caalamka. Kulankan ayaa sidoo kale loo arkaa dadaal cusub oo Faransiisku ku doonayo inuu dib ugu xoojiyo saameyntiisa qaaradda Afrika, xilli sanadihii dambe uu wajahayaay caqabado siyaasadeed iyo dib-u-dhac dhanka xiriirka ah oo ka jiray dalal badan oo Galbeedka Afrika ah.

items.title: Daawo: Banaanbax ka dhan ah mucaaradka oo ka socda qeybo ka mid ah Muqdisho
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Dibadbax ballaaran oo ay soo abaabuleen qaybaha kala duwan ee bulshada ayaa haatan ka socda degmada Kaaraan ee gobolka Banaadir, kaas oo looga soo horjeedo dhaq-dhaqaaqa mucaaradka. Shacab isaga kala yimid degmooyinka dhaca waqooyiga caasimada ayaa isugu soo baxay waddooyinka muhiimka ah, iyaga oo ku qaylinayo erayo ka dhan ah mucaaradka oo iyaguna shalay qabtay dibadbax ka dhan ah dowladda Soomaaliya. Qaar kamid ah dadweynaha ka qayb-galay banaanbaxa ayaa sheegay in aysan aqbali doonin qalalaase laga abuuro degmooyinkooda, ayna ka hortagi doonaan cid kasta oo colaad ka horineyso waqooyiga caasimada. Sidoo kale, waxa ay farriin adag u direen xubnaha mucaaradka oo qaarkood u guuray aagga Mirinaayo, iyaga oo sheegay in aysan suurtagal ahayn inay fowdo abuuraan, ayna qalqal-geliyaan amniga guud ee magaalada Muqdisho. Dareenka shacabka ayaa aad u kacsanaa, waxayna muujiyeen sida ay uga xun yihiin tallaabooyinka mucaaradka oo ay sheegeen inay wax u dhimi karaan nabad-geliyada iyo xasiloonida caasimada. Maalmihii u dambeeyay kooxaha mucaaradka ayaa sare u qaaday dhaq-dhaqaaqooda, waxayna bilaabeen inay ku dibadbaxaan dowladda, iyaga soo abaabulay shacabkii laga barakiciyay dhulalka danta guud ee caasimada Soomaaliya ayaa haatan ku jirto marxalad xasaasi ah, waxaana si weyn la’isugu hayaa hannaanka doorashooyinka iyo wax ka beddelka dastuurka. Si kastaba, ha’ahaatee, lama oga sida ay wax noqon doonaan waxaase laga war sugayaa wada-hadallo xasaasi ah oo la filayo inay u bilowdaan dowladda iyo mucaaradka, kuwaas oo ay garwadeen ka tahay dowlada Mareykanka. The post Daawo: Banaanbax ka dhan ah mucaaradka oo ka socda qeybo ka mid ah Muqdisho appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Xasan Sheekh oo mucaaradka uga adkaaday qodobkii ugu cuslaa ee ay ku doodi jireen
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Doorashooyinkii tooska ahaa ee dhowaan ka dhacay Muqdisho iyo deegaannada Koonfur Galbeed ayaa daaqadda ka tuuray marmarsiiyihii ugu weynaa ee ay gabaadka ka dhigan jireen siyaasiyiinta ka soo horjeeda nidaamka dimoqraadiga ah—dooddii ahayd in Soomaaliya aan marnaba laga qaban karin doorasho qof iyo cod ah. Maanta, xaqiiqada dalku way isbeddeshay, halkaasna waxaa ka dhashay masraxa dood siyaasadeed oo cusub. Weli lama gaarin doorasho qof iyo cod ah oo heer federaal ah, oo ay dhammaan dhinacyadu isku raacsan yihiin. Weli waxaa taagan su’aalo waaweyn oo ku gadaaman hufnaanta, heshiis-siyaasadeedka, madax-bannaanida guddiyada doorashada, iyo in nidaamka aan loo weecin dano xisbi. Hase yeeshee, dhiiranaantii ay lahayd doodda ah “Lama qaban karo” ayaa gabi ahaanba meesha ka baxday. Bishii Diseembar ee sanadkii 2025, caasimadda Muqdisho ayaa martigelisay tijaabadii ugu weyneyd ee doorasho toos ah muddo ka badan nus qarni, iyadoo boqolaal kun oo qof ay isdiiwaangeliyeen. In kasta oo mucaaradku ay qaadaceen geeddi-socodkaas—iyagoo ku andacoonaya in madaxweynuhu uu muddo-kororsi u dan leeyahay, amniga caasimadduna uusan saamaxayn—haddana hal xaqiiqo oo aan la dafiri karin ayaa muuqatay: shacabku sanduuqa way u dareereen. Sawirkaas waxaa sii xoojiyay doorashooyinkii 10-kii May ka dhacay degmooyin ka tirsan gobollada Bay, Bakool, iyo Shabeellaha Hoose ee maamulka Koonfur Galbeed. Dowladda federaalka iyo maamulka Koonfur Galbeed waxay tallaabooyinkan u arkeen caddayn buuxda oo muujinaysa in nidaamka qof iyo cod laga hirgelin karo dalka. Waxay tustay indhaha caalamka iyo kuwa gudahaba in farsamo ahaan iyo amni ahaanba ay suurtagal tahay in doorasho toos ah la qabto, xitaa haddii aysan hal mar wada wada gaari karin gees ka gees dalka. Sidaas darteed, maanta wixii ka dambeeya, cid kasta oo ku doodda “qof iyo cod waa wax aan dhici karin” waxay si toos ah isaga hor keenaysaa xaqiiqo muuqata oo dhulka ka jirta; shacab ayaa Muqdisho ka codeeyay, dad ayaana Koonfur Galbeed codkooda ka dhiibtay. Doodda dhabta ah ee la rabo in maanta diiradda la saaro, ma aha in la diido mabda’a qof iyo cod. Waa in miiska la keeno dood miisaan leh oo ka hadlaysa sidii loo heli lahaa nidaam doorasho oo loo dhan yahay, leh sharci cad, guddiyo madax-bannaan, ka-qaybgal siyaasadeed oo ballaaran, iyo jadwal xalaal ah oo aan loogu danaynayn hal dhinac. Haddii mucaaradku uu yiraahdo “Nidaamka qof iyo cod waan oggolnahay, balse dowladda ayaan lagu aamini karin maamulkiisa,” waa dood caqli gal ah oo mudan in la dhegeysto. Taasi waxay doodda ka weecinaysaa caqabado farsamo, waxayna u wareejinaysaa arrimaha udub-dhexaadka u ah caddaaladda: hufnaanta, dhex-dhexaadnimada, diiwaangelinta cod-bixiyeyaasha, xuquuqda musharraxiinta, iyo ilaalinta xorriyadda ololaha doorashada. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, oo 10-kii May ka hadlayay doorashadii Koonfur Galbeed, ayaa si cad u muujiyay mowqifka xukuumaddiisa. Wuxuu xusay in shacabka Soomaaliyeed ay xaq u leeyihiin inay doortaan hoggaankooda, aayaha dalkana aan mar dambe lagu soo koobi karin faro-ku-tiris siyaasiyiin ah. Farriinta madaxweynaha waxay soo xirtay cutubkii ugu weynaa ee diidmada mucaaradka, iyadoo caddaysay in dowladda federaalku ay go’aansatay in doorashooyinka tooska ah ay ka dhigto dariiqa rasmiga ah ee siyaasadda Soomaaliya. Waa xaqiiqo in nidaamkii doorashada dadban uu dalka u ahaa daawo ku-meel-gaar ah xilligii burburka iyo kala-qoqobka, kana caawiyay in laga baxo faaruq siyaasadeed. Balse muddo kaddib wuxuu isku beddelay cudur. Wuxuu noqday madal ay ku naaxaan dullaaliinta siyaasadda, kaas oo codkii shacabka ku beddelay musuq-maasuq, laaluush, awood dhaqaale, iyo heshiisyo mugdi ah oo qolal xiran lagu kala saxiixdo. Soomaaliya uma baahna, mana xamili karto inay dib ugu laabato godkaas. Haddii nidaamka qof iyo cod la leexiyo, waa in la saxo. Haddii sharcigu dhaliil leeyahay, waa in la kaabaa. Haddii guddiyada lagu muransan yahay, waa in dib u habeyn lagu sameeyaa si loo abuuro kalsooni. Haddii mucaaradka la fogeeyo, waa in loo furo geeddi-socodka. Balse ceebahaas yaryar marnaba marmarsiiyo uma noqon karaan in dalka dib loogu celiyo nidaamkii foosha xumaa ee dadbanaa, kaas oo shacabka intiisa badan ka xayuubinayay xaqa ay leeyihiin. Casharka ka soo baxay Muqdisho iyo Koonfur Galbeed waa dhambaal cad: doodda farsamada iyo suurta-galnimada way dhammaatay, doodda kalsoonida iyo hufnaantuna hadda ayay bilaabatay. Sidaas darted, mucaaradka way ku adkaan doontaa hadda kadib inay caalamka ka gadaan in Soomaaliya loo celiyo doorasho dadban, waxayna ku qasbanaan doonaan inay mabda’ ahaan aqbalaan doorasho toos ah, balse ay ka xaajoodaan wixii ka soo hara. Farriinta madaxweynaha waxay soo xirtay cutubkii ugu weynaa ee diidmada mucaaradka, iyadoo caddaysay in dowladda federaalku ay go’aansatay in doorashooyinka tooska ah ay ka dhigto dariiqa rasmiga ah ee siyaasadda Soomaaliya. Waa xaqiiqo in nidaamkii doorashada dadban uu dalka u ahaa daawo ku-meel-gaar ah xilligii burburka iyo kala-qoqobka, kana caawiyay in laga baxo faaruq siyaasadeed. Balse muddo kaddib wuxuu isku beddelay cudur. Wuxuu noqday madal ay ku naaxaan dullaaliinta siyaasadda, kaas oo codkii shacabka ku beddelay musuq-maasuq, laaluush, awood dhaqaale, iyo heshiisyo mugdi ah oo qolal xiran lagu kala saxiixdo. Soomaaliya uma baahna, mana xamili karto inay dib ugu laabato godkaas. Haddii nidaamka qof iyo cod la leexiyo, waa in la saxo. Haddii sharcigu dhaliil leeyahay, waa in la kaabaa. Haddii guddiyada lagu muransan yahay, waa in dib u habeyn lagu sameeyaa si loo abuuro kalsooni. Haddii mucaaradka la fogeeyo, waa in loo furo geeddi-socodka. Balse ceebahaas yaryar marnaba marmarsiiyo uma noqon karaan in dalka dib loogu celiyo nidaamkii foosha xumaa ee dadbanaa, kaas oo shacabka intiisa badan ka xayuubinayay xaqa ay leeyihiin. Casharka ka soo baxay Muqdisho iyo Koonfur Galbeed waa dhambaal cad: doodda farsamada iyo suurta-galnimada way dhammaatay, doodda kalsoonida iyo hufnaantuna hadda ayay bilaabatay. Sidaas darted, mucaaradka way ku adkaan doontaa hadda kadib inay caalamka ka gadaan in Soomaaliya loo celiyo doorasho dadban, waxayna ku qasbanaan doonaan inay mabda’ ahaan aqbalaan doorasho toos ah, balse ay ka xaajoodaan wixii ka soo hara. items.title: Safaaradda Maraykanka oo Wadda Dadaallo lagu Xallinayo Khilaafka Doorashooyinka Soomaaliya
items.description: Warar ay heshay Warbaahinta Goobjoog ayaa sheegaya in Madaxweynaha Buntilaan, Siciid Cabdullaahi Deni iyo Madaxweynaha Jubbalaan Axmed Maxamed Islaam (Axmed-Madoobe) lagu wado inay 13ka May yimaadaan magaalada Muqdisho, kadib dadaallo ay waddo Safaaradda Mareykanka ee Soomaaliya. Sida wararku tilmaamayaan, Safaaradda Maraykanka ee Muqdisho ayaa bilowday dadaallo diblomaasiyadeed oo lagu doonayo in xal looga gaaro muranka siyaasadeed iyo khilaafka ka taagan hanaanka doorashooyinka dalka, kaddib markii xubnaha mucaaradka ay diideen kulankii uu Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ugu baaqay Madasha Mucaaradka Soomaaliyeed. Safaaradda ayaa la sheegay inay casuumaad u dirtay madaxda maamulada Buntilaan iyo Jubbalaan, sidoo kale, xubnaha Golaha Mustaqbalka iyo siyaasiyiinta mucaaradka, si loo abuuro jawi wadahadal iyo is-afgarad siyaasadeed. Dadaalladan ayaa imanaya xilli ay cirka isku sii shareerayaan xiisadaha siyaasadeed ee la xiriira doorashooyinka qof iyo codka ah, amniga magaalada Muqdisho iyo mowqifyada iska soo horjeeda ee Dawladda Federaalka ah iyo mucaaradka. Ilo xog-ogaal ah ayaa sheegaya in Safaaradda Maraykanku doonayso inay qaadato door dhexdhexaadin ah, si dhinacyada siyaasadda Soomaaliya loogu qanciyo inay miiska wadahadalka ku xalliyaan khilaafaadka jira.

items.title: Somaliland oo si soo kordhaysa uga helaysa…….
items.description: SOMALILAND OO SI SII KORDHAYSA UGA HELAYSA FIIRO GAAR AH WASHINGTON & FILASHOOYINKA AQOONSIGA EE DONALD TRUMP. Waxa qorey; Mohamed Abdi Jama Dhimbiil Geesta Afrika waxay noqotay mid ka mid ah gobollada ugu muhiimsan siyaasadda iyo istiraatiijiyadda caalamka, sababtoo ah waxay ku taallaa marin-badeedka muhiimka ah ee: • Badda Cas • Gacanka Berbera • Marin-badeedka Bab el-Mandeb Isbeddellada amni, dagaallada Bariga Dhexe, loollanka quwadaha waaweyn, iyo tartanka dhaqaale ee dunida ayaa sare u qaaday muhiimadda gobolka. Gudaha xaaladdan cusub, Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland waxay si weyn uga dhex muuqanaysaa doodaha siyaasadeed iyo istiraatiijiyadda ee Washington, gaar ahaan: • Xasiloonideeda • Dimuqraadiyaddeeda • Dekedda Berbera • Goobta juqraafiyadeed ee istiraatiijiga ah. •Doorka ay ka ciyaari karto amniga Badda Cas. 1. MUHIIMADDA ISTIRAATIIJIYEED EE SOMALILAND 1.1 Goobta Juqraafiyeed Somaliland waxay ku taallaa meel istiraatiiji ah oo si toos ah ugu dhow: • Gacanka Berbera • Badda Cas • Bab el-Mandeb Marin-badeedkani wuxuu kamid yahay: • Meelaha ugu mashquulka badan ganacsiga adduunka • Marinada shidaalka caalamka • Waddooyinka maraakiibta ganacsiga dunida. Sababtaas awgeed, quwadaha waaweyn waxay si weyn u daneeyaan cidda gacanta ku haysa ama saaxiibka la ah dalalka iyo deegaannada ku dhow marinnadan. 1.2 Dekedda Berbera Dekedda Berbera waxay noqotay: • Albaab ganacsi • Xarun logistiga maraakiibta • Deked istiraatiiji ah • Aag cashuuraha ka caagan oo weyn . Maalgashiga: iyo sababta Somaliland & Berbera muhiim u yihiin. • Imaaraadka Carabta oo maalgashi weyn ku sameeyey dekeda Berbera iyo Jidka isku xidha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland iyo Ethiopia. • Itoobiya oo ah dalka ugu dadka badan bariga Afrika. • shirkadaha caalamiga ah ee kale ee maalgashaday Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland ayaa sare u qaaday qiimaha istiraatiijiga ah ee Somaliland iyaguna . Washington waxay si gaar ah u eegaysaa muhiimadda Berbera sababtoo ah: • Waxay kaalin ka qaadan kartaa amniga Badda Cas , Bab el-Mandeb iyo Bariga Dhexe. • Waxay noqon kartaa xarun ciidan ama logistig oo muhiim u ah maraykanka maadaama gobolka intiisa kale China joogo. • Waxay yareyn kartaa ku-tiirsanaanta dekedaha kale ee gobolka . 1.3 Xasiloonida iyo Dawladnimada Marka la barbar dhigo Soomaaliya , Somaliland waxay: • Haysataa xasilooni siyaasadeed • Qabataa doorashooyin xor ah • Leedahay hay’ado shaqeeya • Leedahay ciidan iyo nidaam amni oo heer sare ah. Arrimahan ayaa Somaliland ka dhigaya: • Saaxiib amni • Xulafo istiraatiiji ah • Meel lagu kalsoonaan karo 2. SABABAHA WASHINGTON U XIISAYNAYO SOMALILAND 2.1 Amniga Badda Cas, Bab el-Mandeb iyo Gacanka Berbera. Mareykanku wuxuu hadda u arkaa: • Badda Cas • Bab el-Mandeb • Gacanka Berbera • Geesta Afrika • Bariga Dhexe • Hal goob amni iyo istiraatiijiyad isku xidhan. Khataraha: • Xuutiyiinta Yemen • Budhcad-badeedda • Weerarada maraakiibta • Xiisadaha Iran iyo marinka Hormuz ka taagan. ayaa iyaguna sare u qaaday muhiimadda Somaliland. 2.2 Tartanka Shiinaha iyo Mareykanka Shiinaha wuxuu: • Saldhig ciidan ku leeyahay Djibouti. • Maalgashi badan ku leeyahay Afrika. • Xoojinayaa saameyntiisa gobolka Geeska Afrika. Washington waxay ka cabsi qabtaa: • In Shiinuhu xakameeyo marin-badeedka muhiimka ah. • In uu helo dekedo iyo saldhigyo dheeraad ah. Qaar ka mid ah siyaasiyiinta Mareykanka waxay Somaliland u arkaan: • Meel lagu dheelli-tiri karo Shiinaha. • Xulafo cusub oo istiraatiiji ah. 2.3 La-dagaallanka Argagixisada Mareykanka wuxuu muhiimad siinayaa: • Al-Shabaab • ISIS-Somalia • Amniga maraakiibta • Sirdoonka gobolka Somaliland waxay leedahay: • Xasilooni amni • Xeeb dheer 850km dhereran • Meel muhiim u ah la socodka dhaqdhaqaaqyada gobolka. 3. DONALD TRUMP IYO FILASHADA AQOONSIGA. 3.1 Sababta Filashada loo Qabo Filashada aqoonsiga Somaliland waxay sii xoogaysatay kadib: • Aqoonsiga Israel • Xiisadaha Badda Cas & Gobolka • Doodaha Kongareeska Mareykanka Xiisaha ay siyaasiyiinta Jamhuuriga ahi muujiyeen • Tartanka Mareykanka iyo Shiinaha Dad badan waxay rumeysan yihiin in siyaasadda Donald Trump ay: • Ka hormariso danaha istiraatiijiga ah • Doorbido xulafada amniga • Ku saleysan tahay “transactional realism” Taas macnaheedu waa: Mareykanku wuxuu taageeraa cidda: • Danihiisa ilaalin karta • Amniga marin-badeedka sugi karta • Saaxiib amni noqon karta • Khayraad iyo istiraatiijiyad leh 3.2 Qodobada Somaliland Fursadda Siinaya Somaliland waxay leedahay: • Deganaansho siyaasadeed • Doorashooyin • Ciidan shaqeeya • Deked muhiim ah • Xidhiidh istiraatiiji ah oo Itoobiya la leh Qodobadan ayaa sare u qaadaya: • Xiisaha Washington • Doodaha aqoonsiga • Fursadaha iskaashi 4. MAXAA LAGA FILAN KARAA MUSTAQBALKA? 4.1 Aqoonsi Mustaqbalka Dhow Dhici Kara marka la eego; • Xiisaha Washington ee Somaliland . • Xasilid la’aanta Somalia iyo Mareykanka oo niyad xumo ka muujiyey , sidoo kale gabi ahaan joojinaya gargaarkii iyo taageeradii maamulka Muqdisho. • Tartanka Shiinaha ee sii kordhaya maadaama oo marka Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland laga reebo Geesta Afrika oo dhan uu soo degay. • Somaliland oo aduunku u soo jeestay oo wadamo kale oo badan la filayo inay aqoonsadaan . • Danaha Mareykanka ee gobolka Geeska Afrika, Bab el-Mandeb iyo istiraatiijiyadda Somaliland oo sii kordhaya. waxaa suuragal noqon karta: • In maraykanku iyo xulafadiisu aqoonsadaan Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland. Sidoo kale waxaa la filayaa : 4.2 xidhiidhka oo sii xoogaysta; • Xidhiidh diblomaasiyadeed kor loo qaado • Saldhig iyo degsiimo ciidan • Iskaashi amni • Iskaashi sirdoon • Maalgashi dhaqaale • Iskaashi dekedeed Ugu dambayn waxaa la isku raacsan yahay in Donald J Trump iyo Washington sameysanayaan xulafo istaraatiijyadeed oo adag oo Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland na ka mid tahay , waa arin aad aduunku u soo dhaweynayo , waxaana muhiim ah in ururka Midowga Afrika, Qaramada Midoobay iyo Ururada kale ee caalamiga ahi ku qancaan xaqiiqada Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland iyo xuquuqaha ay u halgamaysay 35 sanadood oo loo dhego nuglaado. Mohamed Abdi Jama Dhimbiil Falanqeyn Siyaasadeed oo xiligani taagan.

items.title: Xog: Mareykanka oo dhex-dhexaadinayo dowladda iyo Golaha Mustaqbalka
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Mareykanka ayaa la sheegay inay bilaabeyso dhex-dhexaadinta madaxda Dowladda Federaallka iyo kuwa mucaaradka ee ku midoobay Golaha Mustaqbalka Soomaaliyeed, si looga wada-hadallo xaaladda cakiran ee dalka. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in maalmaha soo socda uu kulan saddex geesood ah ka dhici doono xeyndaabka xerada Xalane, kaas oo ay yeelan doonaan Dowladda Federaalka, Golaha Mustaqbalka iyo Mareykanka, iyadoo diiradda lagu saarayo muranka arrimaha doorashooyinka iyo wax ka beddelka dastuurka. Ilo wareedyo xilkas ah ayaa inoo xaqiijiyay in kulanka loo qorsheeyay inuu dhaco 13-ka bishan, isla markaana ujeedadu tahay in lagu gaaro xal waara oo la xiriira khilaafka sii xoogeysanaya ee u dhexeeya labada dhinac. Sidoo kale, wararka ayaa intaas ku daraya in dhanka dowladda ay shirka ku metali doonaan Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh iyo Ra’iisul wasaare Xamza, halka dhinaca Golaha Mustaqbalka ee meteli doonaan Madaxweyne hore Sheekh Shariif iyo Madaxweynaha Maamulka Puntland Saciid Cabdullahi Deni. Waa kulankii ugu horreeyay ee noociisa ah ee lagu qabanayo Xalane, isla markaana uu garwadeen ka yahay Mareykanka, si loo gaaro xal waara Wadahadalladan la filayo inay bilowdaan ayaa kusoo aaday, iyada oo shalay uu baaqday kulankii uu horay u iclaamiyay Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh, kaas oo qorshuhu ahaa inuu ka dhaco Villa Somalia waxaa ka gows adeegay mucaaradka. Soomaaliya ayaa hadda ku jirto marxalad xasaasi ah, waxaana si wey isku hayo dhinacyada siyaasadda, maadaama lagu jiro xilli adag oo kala guur ah. Si kastaba, lama oga sida ay wax noqon doonaan waxaase laga war sugayaa natiijada wada-hadallada u bilaabanaya dowladda iyo Golaha Mustaqbalka. The post Xog: Mareykanka oo dhex-dhexaadinayo dowladda iyo Golaha Mustaqbalka appeared first on Caasimada Online .

Sidoo kale, wararka ayaa intaas ku daraya in dhanka dowladda ay shirka ku metali doonaan Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh iyo Ra’iisul wasaare Xamza, halka dhinaca Golaha Mustaqbalka ee meteli doonaan Madaxweyne hore Sheekh Shariif iyo Madaxweynaha Maamulka Puntland Saciid Cabdullahi Deni. Waa kulankii ugu horreeyay ee noociisa ah ee lagu qabanayo Xalane, isla markaana uu garwadeen ka yahay Mareykanka, si loo gaaro xal waara Wadahadalladan la filayo inay bilowdaan ayaa kusoo aaday, iyada oo shalay uu baaqday kulankii uu horay u iclaamiyay Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh, kaas oo qorshuhu ahaa inuu ka dhaco Villa Somalia waxaa ka gows adeegay mucaaradka. Soomaaliya ayaa hadda ku jirto marxalad xasaasi ah, waxaana si wey isku hayo dhinacyada siyaasadda, maadaama lagu jiro xilli adag oo kala guur ah. Si kastaba, lama oga sida ay wax noqon doonaan waxaase laga war sugayaa natiijada wada-hadallada u bilaabanaya dowladda iyo Golaha Mustaqbalka.
